statement.zh: 明代著名思想家、文学家李贽因被礼科给事中张问达弹劾“惑世诬民”，被捕入狱。他在狱中不愿接受“剃发”的羞辱，于3月16日夺剃刀自刎，两日后去世。李贽批判程朱理学，提倡“童心说”和个性自由，其思想对晚明社会产生了深远冲击。
statement.en:
Famed Ming-dynasty thinker and writer Li Zhi was imprisoned after being accused by censor Zhang Wenda of 'deceiving the world and corrupting the people.' Unwilling to suffer the humiliation of having his head shaved, he seized a razor and slashed his own throat on March 16, dying two days later. Li Zhi had criticized Neo-Confucianism and advocated the 'theory of childlike mind' and personal freedom; his ideas had a profound impact on late Ming society.

For Asia in 1602, “Li Zhi commits suicide in prison” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Shakespeare's Hamlet first performed

summary.en: Shakespeare's tragedy Hamlet was first staged at the Globe Theatre in London. Drawing on the legend of the Danish prince Amleth, the play explores themes of revenge, madness, morality, and existentialism. The soliloquy 'To be, or not to be' became one of the most famous passages in Western literature. The play is considered the pinnacle of Shakespeare's dramatic art.

title.en: Dutch East India Company officially founded

summary.en: On 20 March the United East India Company (VOC) was formed in Amsterdam by the merger of six city chambers, granted by the States General a monopoly of trade east of the Cape of Good Hope together with rights to make treaties, build forts and raise troops. It raised some 6.5 million guilders by selling shares to the public; the shares paid dividends and could be traded freely o

statement.zh: 3月20日，荷兰联合东印度公司（VOC）由六个城市商会合并成立于阿姆斯特丹。获荷兰议会授予好望角以东贸易与缔约、筑城、募兵的垄断特许。公司向公众发行股票筹得约650万荷兰盾资本，股票按股分红，并可在阿姆斯特丹交易所自由转让——这是世界上第一家现代股份有限公司，也是第一只公开交易的股票。其模式为英国东印度公司等特许企业所仿效，是现代公司制度与证券市场的重要源头。VOC 在此后两个世纪垄断欧亚贸易，建立起庞大的殖民网络。
statement.en: On 20 March the United East India Company (VOC) was formed in Amsterdam by the merger of six city chambers, granted by the States General a monopoly of trade east of the Cape of Good Hope together with rights to make treaties, build forts and raise troops. It raised some 6.5 million guilders by selling shares to the public; the shares paid dividends and could be traded freely on the Amsterdam exchange — the world's first modern joint-stock corporation and the first publicly traded stock. The model was copied by the English East India Company and other chartered ventures, making the VOC a fountainhead of the modern corporation and the securities market. Over the following 200 years it dominated Euro-Asian trade and built a vast colonial network.

en: On 20 March the United East India Company (VOC) was formed in Amsterdam by the merger of six city chambers, granted by the States General a monopoly of trade east of the Cape of Good Hope together with rights to make treaties, build forts and raise troops. It raised some 6.5 million guilders by selling shares to the public; the shares paid dividends and could be traded freely on the Amsterdam exchange — the world's first modern joint-stock corporation and the first publicly traded stock. The model was copied by the English East India Company and other chartered ventures, making the VOC a fountainhead of the modern corporation and the securities market. Over the following 200 years it dominated Euro-Asian trade and built a vast colonial network.

statement.zh: 建州女真首领努尔哈赤在赫图阿拉（今辽宁新宾）进一步完善旗制，初设四旗：黄、白、红、蓝，每旗300人，后增至400人。八旗制度“以旗统人，以旗统兵”，兼具行政、军事和生产职能，极大地增强了女真族的动员能力和凝聚力，成为后金（清）崛起的关键组织基础。
statement.en:
Jianzhou Jurchen chieftain Nurhaci, based in Hetu Ala (present-day Xinbin, Liaoning), further developed the banner system, initially creating four banners: yellow, white, red, and blue, each with 300 men (later increased to 400). The Eight Banners system unified administration, military, and production, greatly enhancing Jurchen mobilization and cohesion. It became the key organizational foundation for the rise of the Later Jin (Qing).

For Asia in 1605, “Nurhaci establishes embryonic Eight Banners system” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Flight of the Earls in Ireland

summary.en: Irish earls Hugh O'Neill and Rory O'Donnell, having failed in their resistance to English rule, secretly sailed from Lough Swilly with 90 followers, fleeing to Spain. This 'Flight of the Earls' led England to implement the Plantation of Ulster, moving Scots and English Protestants into the province, profoundly altering Ireland's religious and ethnic makeup.

statement.zh:
爱尔兰伯爵休·奥尼尔和罗里·奥唐奈因反抗英格兰统治失败，率90名追随者从爱尔兰斯威利湖秘密乘船逃往西班牙，史称“伯爵出逃”。此举导致英格兰在爱尔兰阿尔斯特省推行大规模殖民计划（阿尔斯特种植园），将苏格兰和英格兰新教徒迁入，深刻改变了爱尔兰的宗教和民族格局。

title.en: Monteverdi's opera L'Orfeo premieres

summary.en: Claudio Monteverdi's opera L'Orfeo premiered at the court of Mantua. Based on the Greek myth of Orpheus descending to the underworld to rescue his wife, it is the earliest opera still regularly performed. Monteverdi used a rich orchestra and expressive techniques, establishing the early operatic form and advancing Baroque music.

title.en: France establishes Quebec City

summary.en: On July 3, French explorer Samuel de Champlain founded Quebec City (meaning 'where the river narrows') on the St. Lawrence River as a base for fur trade and colonial expansion. Champlain allied with the Algonquin and Huron tribes against the Iroquois. Quebec became the capital of New France and the heart of French North America. Champlain is known as the 'Father of New France'.

title.en: Kepler publishes his laws of planetary motion

summary.en: In 1609 Kepler, drawing on Tycho Brahe’s precise observations, publishes Astronomia nova with the first two laws of planetary motion: planets move in ellipses around the Sun, and a line from the Sun to a planet sweeps equal areas in equal times. title.en: Twelve Years' Truce signed; Dutch independence effectively recognized

title.en: Bank of Amsterdam established: prototype of modern central bank

summary.en: In 1609, the City of Amsterdam established the Bank of Amsterdam (Amsterdamsche Wisselbank), widely recognized as the world's first modern central bank prototype. It accepted deposits, performed transfer clearing, and issued banknotes (Amsterdam bills) backed by precious metals. Known for honest and stable currency management, Amsterdam bills became the standard settlement inst

statement.zh:
公元1609年，阿姆斯特丹市议会设立了阿姆斯特丹银行（Bank of Amsterdam），被公认为世界上第一家现代中央银行的雏形。该银行接受存款、进行转账结算，发行与贵金属挂钩的银行票据（"阿姆斯特丹汇票"）。银行以诚实可靠的货币管理闻名，阿姆斯特丹汇票成为国际贸易的标准结算工具，为荷兰17世纪的"黄金时代"提供了金融基础。

summary.en: The royal physician spent sixteen years synthesizing Korean and Chinese medical learning into a systematic compendium of East Asian medicine.

statement.zh:
御医许浚历16年集朝鲜与中国医籍之大成，分内景、外形、杂病等门，为东亚传统医学的集成之作。编纂以分类与条目整理医理、方剂与针灸，兼采朝鲜本土经验；刊行后成为医者常用参考。它体现东亚医学的交流与整合。

把「许浚编成《东医宝鉴》」放回1610年的朝鲜，可以看到医学变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en:
In the 16th year of his reign, imperial physician Xu Junli compiled a comprehensive collection of Korean and Chinese medical books, divided into internal scenes, external appearances, and miscellaneous diseases. It is a comprehensive work of East Asian traditional medicine. The compilation organizes medical theory, prescriptions and acupuncture into categories and entries, and draws on local Korean experience; after its publication, it became a common reference for doctors. It embodies the exchange and integration of East Asian medicine. Putting "Heo Jun's "Dongui Bogam" back to Korea in 1610, we can see a specific aspect of medical changes.

It sits within the timeline's chronological coverage of Joseon and medicine history.

title.en: Beijing inner city wall completed

summary.en: After many years of construction, the inner city wall of Beijing (the later Ming-Qing Beijing city) was fully completed. The wall was about 24 km in circumference, 12 meters high, with nine gates. statement.zh: 历经多年修建，北京内城（即后来的明清北京城）完全建成，城墙周长约24公里，高12米，设9座城门。北京城成为当时世界上规模最大、规划最完整的都城之一，奠定了今日北京旧城的基础。明神宗朱翊钧虽然怠政，但北京城的修缮和扩建仍在继续。
statement.en:
After many years of construction, the inner city wall of Beijing (the later Ming-Qing Beijing city) was fully completed. The wall was about 24 km in circumference, 12 meters high, with 9 gates. Beijing became one of the largest and best-planned capital cities in the world at that time, laying the foundation for today's old Beijing. Despite his neglect of state affairs, Emperor Shenzong allowed the renovation and expansion of Beijing to continue.

For Asia in 1610, “Beijing inner city wall completed” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: King James I authorizes publication of the King James Bible

summary.en: The Church of England officially published the King James Version (KJV) of the Bible. Translated by 54 scholars over seven years, it combined the strengths of the Tyndale and Geneva Bibles, with beautiful and elegant language. It became the most influential English Bible, profoundly shaping English literature and culture.

statement.zh: 英格兰教会正式出版《钦定版圣经》（又称《詹姆斯王圣经》）。该译本由54位学者历时7年完成，融合了丁道尔和日内瓦圣经的优点，语言优美典雅。它成为英语世界最具影响力的圣经译本，深刻影响了英语文学和英国文化。
statement.en:
The Church of England officially published the King James Version (KJV) of the Bible. Translated by 54 scholars over 7 years, it combined the strengths of the Tyndale and Geneva Bibles, with beautiful and elegant language. It became the most influential English Bible, profoundly shaping English literature and culture.

For Europe in 1611, “King James I authorizes publication of the King James Bible” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: English East India Company establishes first factory in Surat

summary.en: The English East India Company fleet under Thomas Best defeated the Portuguese navy off Surat in northwestern India. Mughal Emperor Jahangir consequently granted the English permission to establish a factory and trade privileges in Surat. This was the first permanent English foothold in the Indian subcontinent, marking the beginning of English penetration into India.

title.en: Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth invades Russia, Moscow falls

summary.en: King Sigismund III of Poland exploited Russia's Time of Troubles, supporting False Dmitry II in his claim to the tsardom. Polish forces under Stanisław Żółkiewski entered Moscow and placed Sigismund's son Władysław as tsar. However, a Russian patriotic uprising expelled the Poles the following year. This episode spurred the rise of the Romanov dynasty.

title.en: Galileo observes Neptune (but does not confirm it as a planet)

summary.en: On December 28, while observing Jupiter and its moons, Galileo recorded the position of a 'star.' He had actually observed Neptune, but its extremely slow motion led him to think it was a fixed star, not a planet. Neptune was not officially discovered until 1846. This was the earliest telescopic observation of Neptune in history.

statement.zh:
12月28日，伽利略在观测木星及其卫星时，记录下一个“恒星”的位置。实际上他观测到了海王星，但由于其视运动极慢，他认为是一颗普通恒星，未意识到是行星。直到1846年海王星才被正式发现。这是历史上最早的望远镜观测海王星记录。

title.en: Successful tobacco cultivation in Jamestown

summary.en: English colonist John Rolfe successfully cultivated the West Indian tobacco variety 'Orinoco' at Jamestown and exported it to Europe. Tobacco immediately became the most important cash crop and export commodity of the Virginia Colony, saving it from near collapse, but also leading to heavy reliance on African slave labor.

title.en: Gu Yanwu advocates practical learning

summary.en: Late-Ming scholar Gu Yanwu writes the Rizhilu, urging statecraft learning and coining the idea that the nation's fate concerns every man.

statement.zh: 明末清初学者顾炎武著《日知录》《天下郡国利病书》，主张经世致用，提出天下兴亡匹夫有责。他反对空谈心性，强调实地考察、地理沿革与制度利弊的研究，把学问与国计民生相连；其笔记体著作按条目积累，涉及政治、经济、风俗与文献。后人辑其治学方法为清代朴学先声。
statement.en: Gu Yanwu, a beginner in the late Ming and Qing Dynasties, wrote "Rizhilu" and "Book of Benefits and Diseases of the Prefectures and Countries of the World", which advocated practical management of the world and proposed that everyone is responsible for the rise and fall of the world.

title.en: Netherlands establishes New Netherland colony

summary.en: The Dutch States General granted a monopoly to the newly formed 'New Netherland Company' to establish the colony of New Netherland along the Hudson River, covering present-day New York and New Jersey. The company built Fort Nassau (later Fort Amsterdam) at the southern tip of Manhattan Island. This marked the formal Dutch colonial rule in North America.

title.en: Treaty of Aschburg between Venice and Habsburgs

summary.en: The Republic of Venice and the Habsburg monarchy (Emperor Matthias) signed the Treaty of Aschburg, ending the Uskok War (1615-1618). Venice renounced some commercial privileges in the Adriatic, while the Habsburgs promised to disband the Uskok pirates. The treaty temporarily stabilized Adriatic trade but did not resolve underlying conflicts.

title.en: The Blue Mosque is completed in Istanbul

summary.en: Sultan Ahmed I built the Sultan Ahmed Mosque, famed for its six minarets and blue Iznik tiles, a masterpiece of Ottoman architecture.

statement.zh:

title.en: Dutch East India Company captures Jakarta, renames it Batavia

summary.en: Dutch East India Company Governor-General Jan Pieterszoon Coen led a fleet to capture the important port of Jakarta from the Banten Sultanate. He razed the city and rebuilt it, renaming it 'Batavia'. Batavia became the capital of the Dutch East Indies and the VOC's Asian headquarters, remaining under Dutch rule until Indonesian independence in 1949.

title.en: Treaty of Stolbovo signed; Sweden gains large territory

summary.en: On February 27, Sweden and Russia signed the Treaty of Stolbovo, ending the Russo-Swedish War (1614-1617). Sweden gained Ingria (the region around present-day Leningrad) and Kexholm (parts of Karelia), controlling the Neva River estuary and access to the Baltic. Russia lost its Baltic outlet, which it would not regain until the time of Peter the Great.

title.en: Kepler proposes third law of planetary motion

summary.en: German astronomer Johannes Kepler published his third law in 'Harmonices Mundi': the square of a planet's orbital period is proportional to the cube of the semi-major axis of its orbit. This law unified the motions of all planets in the solar system and provided the mathematical foundation for Newton's law of universal gravitation.

title.en: Defenestration of Prague; Thirty Years' War breaks out

summary.en: On May 23, Bohemian Protestant nobles, angered by Emperor Matthias and Archduke Ferdinand's restrictions on religious freedom, stormed Prague Castle and threw two imperial governors, Wilhelm von Slavata and Jaroslav von Martinitz, out of a window. They landed in a pile of manure and survived. This event sparked the Thirty Years' War (1618-1648), one of the most devastating conf

title.en: Bohemia elects Frederick V as king; Czech revolt begins

summary.en: The Bohemian rebel nobles elected Frederick V of the Palatinate (leader of the Protestant Union) as king, seeking to break free from Habsburg rule. This led Holy Roman Emperor Ferdinand II to ally with the Catholic League to crush the revolt; the rebellion failed after the Battle of White Mountain (1620).

statement.zh: 明万历47年（1619年），明廷派杨镐率四路大军（约8万至11万人）围剿后金。努尔哈赤采取“凭尔几路来，我只一路去”的策略，集中6万兵力逐一击破，明军三路被歼，一路溃逃。萨尔浒之战是明清战争的关键转折点，后金从此由防御转为攻势，明朝在辽东的统治濒临崩溃。
statement.en:
In the 47th year of Wanli (1619), the Ming court sent Yang Hao with four armies (80,000–110,000 men) to suppress Later Jin. Nurhaci adopted the strategy 'no matter how many roads you come, I take one road' and concentrated 60,000 troops to defeat the Ming armies one by one. Three Ming armies were annihilated and one fled. The Battle of Sarhu was a decisive turning point in the Ming-Qing transition; from then on, Later Jin shifted from defense to offense, and Ming control in Liaodong collapsed.

For Asia in 1619, “Battle of Sarhu; Later Jin defeats Ming army” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Wang Fuzhi synthesizes materialist Confucianism

summary.en: Wang Fuzhi critiqued idealist Confucianism and Buddhism, holding that principle inheres in qi, a peak of late-imperial materialist thought.

statement.zh: 王夫之系统批判心学与佛老，主张理在气中、习成而性与，明清之际唯物思潮代表。他坚持理不离气，认为历史与制度应随势而变，反对以空疏的心性讨论代替对现实秩序的分析；明清之际的动荡使其思想带有反思与经世的色彩。其学说在后世被重新发掘，成为理解中国早期现代思想的重要资源。
statement.en: Wang Euzhi systematically criticized the philosophy of mind and Buddhism, advocating that principles are in the Qi and that nature is harmonized through habituation.

title.en: Mayflower arrives in North America; Mayflower Compact signed

summary.en: On September 16, 102 English Puritans and 'strangers' (non-religious emigrants) sailed from Plymouth on the Mayflower. After 66 days, on November 11, they arrived at Cape Cod (present-day Massachusetts). statement.zh: 9月16日，102名英国清教徒和“陌生人”（非宗教移民）乘坐“五月花号”从普利茅斯出发，经过66天航行，于11月11日抵达科德角（今马萨诸塞州）。登陆前，41名成年男性在船上签署了《五月花号公约》，约定建立“公民政治团体”并制定公正平等的法律。该公约被视为美国自治精神的源头和第一部宪法性文件。
statement.en:
On September 16, 102 English Puritans and 'strangers' (non-religious emigrants) sailed from Plymouth on the Mayflower. After 66 days, on November 11, they arrived at Cape Cod (present-day Massachusetts). Before landing, 41 adult males signed the Mayflower Compact, agreeing to form a 'civil body politic' and to enact just and equal laws. The compact is regarded as a source of American self-government and as the first constitutional document in the New World.

For North America in 1620, “Mayflower arrives in North America; Mayflower Compact signed” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Pope Urban VIII ascends; supports Galileo initially

summary.en: Maffeo Barberini was elected Pope Urban VIII. He had been a friend and patron of Galileo in his earlier years and was sympathetic to astronomy. Early in his papacy, he allowed Galileo to continue his research as long as he treated geocentrism and heliocentrism even-handedly. However, after Galileo published 'Dialogue' in 1632, the Pope felt offended, leading to Galileo's trial.

statement.zh:

title.en: Cardinal Richelieu enters French royal council

summary.en: Cardinal Armand Jean du Plessis de Richelieu, chief minister to Louis XIII, entered the royal council and soon became the de facto prime minister. He pursued centralization, suppressed the Huguenots and aristocratic rebellions, and intervened in the Thirty Years' War to weaken the Habsburgs. Richelieu's rule laid the foundations for French absolute monarchy and continental hege

statement.zh:
路易十三的首席大臣、红衣主教阿尔芒·让·迪·普莱西·德·黎塞留进入法国枢密院，并很快成为实际上的首相。他推行中央集权，打击胡格诺派和贵族叛乱，并介入三十年战争以削弱哈布斯堡家族。黎塞留的统治奠定了法国绝对君主制和欧陆霸权的基础。

title.en: Dutch occupy southern Taiwan; build Fort Zeelandia

summary.en: The Dutch East India Company, with tacit consent from the Ming Fujian authorities, established a base at Tayouan (present-day Anping, Tainan) in Taiwan. They built Fort Zeelandia and Fort Provintia, gradually controlling the southern and western coasts of Taiwan. The Dutch used it as an entrepot for trade between China, Japan, and Southeast Asia until they were expelled by Zhen

statement.zh:
荷兰东印度公司从明朝福建当局取得默许，在台湾大员（今台南安平）建立据点。他们修建了热兰遮城（Zeelandia）和普罗民遮城，逐步控制台湾南部和西海岸。荷兰人以此为基地进行中国、日本和东南亚之间的转口贸易，直到1662年被郑成功驱逐。

title.en: Virginia colony introduces black slavery

summary.en: The Virginia colonial assembly passed legislation establishing 'lifelong servitude for blacks.' Previously, a few blacks had been indentured servants who could gain freedom after their term. From 1624, colonial law began to define slavery based on race, legalizing slavery in British North America and profoundly shaping the social structure of the American South.

title.en: Dutch West India Company captures Pernambuco, Brazil

summary.en: The Dutch West India Company fleet captured the Portuguese colony of Pernambuco (present-day Recife, Brazil) and established 'New Holland' colony. title.en: Grotius publishes On the Law of War and Peace

summary.en: Dutch jurist Hugo Grotius publishes On the Law of War and Peace, systematically expounding natural law and the rules of war, regarded as the founding work of international law.

statement.zh: 荷兰法学家格劳秀斯出版《战争与和平法》，系统阐述自然法与战争规则，被誉为国际法奠基之作。他把自然法从神学与习俗中分离，主张以人的理性与社会性为规范来源，并讨论战争的正当理由、交战规则与条约效力。著作回应当时的宗教与领土冲突，为后世国际法提供了概念框架。

title.en: Saint Kitts becomes Anglo-French joint colony

title.en: Académie Française founded

summary.en: French Prime Minister Richelieu officially established the Académie Française, aiming to standardize the French language and literature. The academy consists of 40 lifelong members ('the immortals') who compile dictionaries and regulate grammar. It is France's most authoritative academic institution and still guards the purity of the French language.

title.en: First Manchu Invasion of Korea

summary.en: The Later Jin invaded over Joseon's loyalty to Ming; King Injo fled to Ganghwa and accepted a treaty of brotherhood with the Manchus.

statement.zh:
后金以朝鲜亲明为由发兵渡江，仁祖避入江华岛，被迫与后金结为兄弟之国，明朝在半岛的影响开始动摇。后金军避开坚城，直趋王京，迫使朝鲜议和；条约规定互市与贡纳，朝鲜在明清之间处境两难。此后清军再次南下，宗藩关系进一步改变。

把「丁卯胡乱」放回1627年的朝鲜，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Harvey describes blood circulation

summary.en: In 1628 the English physician William Harvey publishes De motu cordis, arguing by experiment and quantitative reasoning that blood is pumped by the heart and circulates through the body by arteries and veins, rather than being made in the liver and consumed in the organs as the old doctrine held. The work founds modern physiology and experimental medicine.

statement.zh:
1628年，英国医生威廉·哈维出版《心血运动论》，以实验与定量论证血液由心脏泵出、经动脉与静脉在体内循环，而非旧说所谓在肝脏生成、于器官消耗。这一发现奠定近代生理学与实验医学的基础。

1628年的英国，「哈维阐明血液循环」属于科技领域。

title.en: Rubens paints The Battle of the Amazons

title.en: Milan Plague

summary.en: Around 1630 plague rages through Lombardy and Milan, killing hundreds of thousands and emptying the city. The crisis prompts early quarantine, isolation and health inspection, later evoked by Manzoni in The Betrothed.

title.en: Charles I dissolves Parliament; begins Personal Rule

summary.en: Charles I, frustrated by Parliament's refusal to grant taxes, used his prerogative to dissolve Parliament and did not call another for 11 years (1629-1640), a period known as the 'Eleven Years' Tyranny' or 'Personal Rule'. He raised revenue through 'ship money' and other extra-parliamentary means, violating property rights and deepening social conflict.

statement.zh: 十月，后金汗皇太极率军绕开山海关，从喜峰口破长城，攻陷遵化，直逼北京。明廷震动，袁崇焕率关宁铁骑星夜驰援，在北京广渠门外击退后金。但崇祯帝中了皇太极的反间计，于十二月逮捕袁崇焕，最终导致袁崇焕被冤杀。
statement.en:
In the tenth lunar month, Later Jin khan Hong Taiji led his forces past Shanhai Pass, breached the Great Wall at Xifengkou, captured Zunhua, and drove straight toward Beijing. The Ming court panicked. Yuan Chonghuan rushed with his Guanning Iron Cavalry to relieve Beijing and repelled the Later Jin outside Guangqu Gate. But the Chongzhen emperor, falling for Hong Taiji's ruse, arrested Yuan Chonghuan in December, leading to Yuan's eventual unjust execution.

For Asia in 1629, “Jisi Incident; Later Jin reaches Beijing” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: King Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden lands in Germany, enters Thirty Years' War

summary.en: On July 6, King Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden landed with 13,000 elite troops on the island of Usedom in Pomerania, formally entering the Thirty Years' War. He supported the Protestant princes against the Catholic League and the Habsburgs. Gustavus reformed military tactics (using light field guns and linear formations) and is known as the 'father of modern warfare'.

statement.zh:
7月6日，瑞典国王古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫率1.3万精兵在波美拉尼亚的乌瑟多姆岛登陆，正式介入三十年战争。他支持新教诸侯对抗天主教联盟和哈布斯堡。古斯塔夫改革了军事战术（使用轻便火炮、线性战术），被誉为“现代战争之父”。

title.en: Great Puritan Migration: Winthrop's fleet arrives in Massachusetts

summary.en: On April 8, John Winthrop led about 700 Puritans on 11 ships from England; they arrived in Massachusetts Bay in June, establishing multiple settlements, including Boston, and forming the Massachusetts Bay Colony. This large migration (about 20,000 people by 1640) laid the demographic and cultural foundation of New England.

statement.zh: 4月8日，约翰·温思罗普率领约700名清教徒和11艘船从英格兰启航，6月抵达马萨诸塞湾。他们在波士顿等地建立了多个定居点，并成立马萨诸塞湾殖民地。这次大规模移民（至1640年约2万人）奠定了新英格兰的人口和文化基础。
statement.en:
On April 8, John Winthrop led about 700 Puritans on 11 ships from England; they arrived in Massachusetts Bay in June, establishing multiple settlements, including Boston, and forming the Massachusetts Bay Colony. This large migration (about 20,000 people by 1640) laid the demographic and cultural foundation of New England.

For North America in 1630, “Great Puritan Migration: Winthrop's fleet arrives in Massachusetts” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: The 1631 eruption of Vesuvius

summary.en: In 1631 Mount Vesuvius near Naples erupts violently again; hot pyroclastics and mudflows destroy surrounding towns and kill thousands, beginning a long active phase after the volcano’s 1631 awakening.

title.en: Battle of Breitenfeld; Swedish army crushes Catholic League

summary.en: On September 17, King Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden faced Count Tilly's Catholic League army at Breitenfeld in Saxony. Using flexible firepower and linear tactics, Gustavus won a decisive victory, shattering the myth of Catholic invincibility. This battle established Sweden as a military power in Europe.

statement.zh:
9月17日，瑞典国王古斯塔夫二世率军与蒂利伯爵指挥的天主教联盟军队在萨克森的布赖滕费尔德交战。古斯塔夫运用灵活的火力和线性战术，取得决定性胜利，打破了天主教军队不可战胜的神话。此战确立了瑞典在欧洲的军事霸权。

1631年的瑞典，「布赖滕费尔德会战，瑞典大胜天主教联盟」属于军事领域。

title.en: Magdeburg falls; city sacked

summary.en: On May 20, the Catholic League army under Papenheim and Tilly captured the Protestant stronghold of Magdeburg. The city was set on fire, and about 20,000 residents were killed (only about 4,000 survived). This atrocity, known as the 'Magdeburg Wedding,' shocked Europe and intensified Protestant resistance.

title.en: Rembrandt paints 'The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp'

summary.en: The 26-year-old Rembrandt van Rijn completed the group portrait 'The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp'. The painting, with its dramatic lighting and dynamic composition, broke from stiff conventions of group portraiture, making him instantly famous and one of Amsterdam's most sought-after painters.

title.en: Battle of Lützen; King Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden killed

summary.en: On November 16, the Swedish and Protestant allied army fought the Imperial army under Wallenstein at Lützen. Although the Swedes won, Gustavus Adolphus was shot dead while leading a charge in heavy fog. His death deprived the Protestant alliance of its central leader, but Sweden continued to fight until the peace of 1648.

title.en: Galileo publishes 'Dialogue Concerning the Two Chief World Systems'

summary.en: In February, Galileo published 'Dialogue Concerning the Two Chief World Systems' in Florence. The book, in the form of a conversation among three people, compared the Ptolemaic and Copernican systems, clearly favoring Copernicus. This angered Pope Urban VIII, leading to Galileo's trial and house arrest the following year.

title.en: Ming scientist Xu Guangqi dies

summary.en: On November 8, Ming dynasty scientist and statesman Xu Guangqi died in Beijing. He held positions including Minister of Rites and Grand Secretary of the Wen Yuan Pavilion. He translated Euclid's 'Elements', 'Hydraulic Machines of the West', compiled 'Complete Treatise on Agriculture', and helped revise the calendar. He was a key figure in the East-West transmission of science a

statement.zh: 11月8日，明代科学家、政治家徐光启在北京去世。他历任礼部尚书、文渊阁大学士，翻译《几何原本》《泰西水法》，编著《农政全书》，并参与修订历法。他是西学东渐的关键人物，也是中国近代科学先驱。
statement.en:
On November 8, Ming dynasty scientist and statesman Xu Guangqi died in Beijing. He held positions including Minister of Rites and Grand Secretary of the Wen Yuan Pavilion. He translated Euclid's 'Elements', 'Hydraulic Machines of the West', compiled 'Complete Treatise on Agriculture', and helped revise the calendar. He was a key figure in the East-West transmission of science and a pioneer of modern science in China.

For Asia in 1633, “Ming scientist Xu Guangqi dies” is a traceable node of Technology change whose significance is best read through later events.

zh: 11月8日，明代科学家、政治家徐光启在北京去世。他历任礼部尚书、文渊阁大学士，翻译《几何原本》《泰西水法》，编著《农政全书》，并参与修订历法。他是西学东渐的关键人物，也是中国近代科学先驱。
11月8日，明代科学家、政治家徐光启在北京去世。
en: On November 8, Ming dynasty scientist and statesman Xu Guangqi died in Beijing. He held positions including Minister of Rites and Grand Secretary of the Wen Yuan Pavilion. title.en: Dutch monopoly on Amboyna clove trade

summary.en: The Dutch East India Company, through force, compelled clove growers on Amboyna and neighboring islands to sign monopoly contracts and had excess clove trees destroyed to control global clove prices. This brutal monopoly brought huge profits to the Dutch but devastated local economies.

statement.zh:
荷兰东印度公司通过武力强迫安汶岛和周围岛屿的丁香种植者签订垄断合同，销毁多余的丁香树，以控制全球丁香价格。这种残酷的垄断政策使荷兰在香料贸易中获取暴利，但导致当地经济凋敝。

1635年的荷兰，「荷兰垄断安汶岛丁香贸易」属于经济领域。

statement.en:
Late Ming scientist Song Yingxing published 'Tiangong Kaiwu' (The Exploitation of the Works of Nature) in Fenyi, Jiangxi. The work consists of 3 volumes and 18 chapters, systematically recording traditional Chinese agricultural and industrial techniques, including metallurgy, textiles, ceramics, papermaking, sugar production, and more than 30 other industries. It is known as the 'seventeenth-century Chinese encyclopedia of crafts'.

For Asia in 1637, “Song Yingxing publishes 'Tiangong Kaiwu' (Exploitation of the Works of Nature)” is a traceable node of Technology change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Qing forces break through to Jinan; Ming northern crisis worsens

summary.en: Qing emperor Hong Taiji led his forces around the Guanning defense line, broke through the Great Wall at Miyun, and captured Jinan. They seized the Prince of De, Zhu Youshu, and plundered a large number of people and goods. This campaign deepened the Ming fiscal and military crisis, allowing Li Zicheng and other peasant forces to grow stronger.

statement.zh: 清太宗皇太极率军绕过关宁防线，从密云破长城，攻占济南，俘虏德王朱由枢，并掠夺大批人口和财物。此役加重了明朝的财政和军事危机，李自成等农民军趁机发展壮大。

title.en: Dutch first record dodo bird on Mauritius

title.en: Tokugawa shogunate issues final isolation edict; Portuguese expelled

summary.en: The Tokugawa shogunate issued its final seclusion edict, expelling the Portuguese and forbidding any Japanese from traveling abroad or returning. Thereafter, Japan allowed only Chinese and Dutch ships to trade at Nagasaki's Dejima, completing the 'sakoku' isolation system.

title.en: First Bishops' War between England and Scotland breaks out

summary.en: Charles I's attempt to impose an English-style prayer book and episcopacy on Scotland sparked a Scottish revolt. title.en: Battle of the Downs; Dutch defeat Spanish fleet

summary.en: On October 21, the Dutch navy under Maarten Tromp defeated the remnants of the Spanish Armada in the English anchorage of the Downs. This battle destroyed Spain's last naval power; the Dutch replaced Spain as the dominant sea power and consolidated their independence.

title.en: Portugal regains independence from Spain

summary.en: On December 1, Portuguese nobles, dissatisfied with Habsburg rule, staged a coup in Lisbon and declared independence, acclaiming the Duke of Braganza as King John IV. Spain, embroiled in the Thirty Years' War, could not suppress the rebellion. Portugal thus regained its independence, ending the 60-year Iberian Union.

statement.zh:
12月1日，葡萄牙贵族因不满西班牙哈布斯堡王朝的高压统治，在里斯本发动政变，宣布独立，拥戴布拉干萨公爵若昂为葡萄牙国王（若昂四世）。西班牙忙于三十年战争，无力镇压。葡萄牙由此恢复独立，结束60年的伊比利亚联盟。

title.en: Descartes publishes Meditations

summary.en: Rene Descartes published the 'Meditations on First Philosophy', establishing 'I think, therefore I am' through systematic doubt and laying the cornerstone of modern epistemology.

title.en: Boston founded

summary.en: The Massachusetts Bay Colony founded Boston on the Shawmut peninsula; with its port and colleges it grew into a cultural and intellectual hub of North America.

statement.zh: 马萨诸塞湾殖民地在肖穆特半岛建波士顿，凭港口与学府渐成北美文化与思想重镇。港口带来贸易与移民，清教徒的教会与印刷业聚集，使城市在新英格兰的殖民地网络中占据中心位置；学院与出版物又让波士顿成为思想讨论的场所。城市的发展显示了港口、宗教与知识机构如何共同塑造殖民地的都市中心。

title.en: Irish Catholic Rebellion breaks out

summary.en: In October, Irish Catholics in Ulster rose in rebellion, massacring thousands of Protestant settlers. The rebellion quickly spread across the country, leading to the establishment of the Irish Catholic Confederation (Confederation of Kilkenny). This marked the beginning of the Irish Confederate Wars (1641-1653) and an extension of the English Civil War.

statement.zh:
10月，爱尔兰天主教徒在阿尔斯特起义，屠杀数千新教殖民者。起义迅速蔓延全国，建立了爱尔兰天主教邦联（基尔肯尼邦联）。这是1641-1653年爱尔兰邦联战争的开始，也是英国内战的延伸。

1641年的爱尔兰，「爱尔兰天主教起义爆发」属于军事领域。

title.en: Rembrandt completes 'The Night Watch'

summary.en: Rembrandt painted the group portrait 'The Night Watch' (original title 'The Militia Company of Captain Frans Banninck Cocq') for the Amsterdam civic guard. Breaking with conventional static grouping, he used dramatic motion and chiaroscuro. Some patrons were displeased with the placement of figures, but it later became one of his most celebrated masterpieces.

1642年的荷兰，「荷兰画家伦勃朗完成《夜巡》」属于艺术领域。

title.en: Dutch explorer Tasman discovers New Zealand

summary.en: Dutch East India Company explorer Abel Tasman, sailing from Java, on December 13 sighted the west coast of the South Island, naming it 'Staten Landt' (later changed to New Zealand). He continued north, discovering Fiji and Tonga. Though Tasman did not land, he proved that Australia was not connected to Antarctica.

statement.zh:
荷兰东印度公司探险家阿贝尔·塔斯曼率船队从爪哇出发，12月13日发现南岛西海岸，命名为“斯塔滕地”（后改新西兰）。他继续北上，发现斐济和汤加。塔斯曼虽未登陆，但证明了澳大利亚并非与南极相连。

1642年的荷兰，「荷兰探险家塔斯曼发现新西兰」属于科技领域。

title.en: Galileo dies

summary.en: In 1642 Galileo dies at Arcetri near Florence at 77. In old age, for supporting the heliocentric view, he is sentenced by the Church to life confinement and made to recant, yet his writings and observations ground the method of modern experimental science.

8月22日，查理一世在诺丁汉升起皇家军旗，向议会宣战。议会派（圆颅党）与保皇派（骑士党）之间的战争爆发。议会军最初失利，但凭借克伦威尔组织的“新模范军”最终获胜。内战导致国王被俘和处决，共和政体建立。

statement.en:
On August 22, Charles I raised his royal standard at Nottingham, declaring war on Parliament. The war between the Parliamentarians (Roundheads) and Royalists (Cavaliers) began. Initially Parliament's forces fared poorly, but with the 'New Model Army' organized by Oliver Cromwell, they eventually won. The war led to the king's capture and execution and the establishment of a republic.

For Europe in 1642, “English Civil War breaks out” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: French mathematician Pascal invents mechanical calculator

summary.en: Blaise Pascal, to assist his father in tax calculations, invented the 'Pascaline', a mechanical calculator capable of addition and subtraction. It was the first mechanical calculator in history, laying the foundation for modern computers.

statement.zh:
布莱兹·帕斯卡为了帮助父亲计算税收，发明了“帕斯卡计算器”（Pascaline），能进行加减法。这是世界上第一台机械计算器，为现代计算机的发展奠定了基础。

1642年的法国，「法国数学家帕斯卡发明机械计算器」属于科技领域。
statement.en: In order to help his father calculate taxes, Blaise Pascal invented the "Pascaline", which can perform addition and subtraction.

title.en: Li Zicheng proclaims himself 'New Shun King' at Xiangyang

title.en: Newton born

summary.en: In 1643 Isaac Newton is born at Woolsthorpe in Lincolnshire, England. Founder of classical mechanics, calculus and optics, he publishes the Principia in 1687 with the law of universal gravitation and the three laws of motion, founding modern physics.

title.en: Torricelli invents mercury barometer

summary.en: Italian physicist Evangelista Torricelli filled a long glass tube with mercury and inverted it into a mercury basin; he found that the mercury column stabilized at about 76 cm, proving the existence of atmospheric pressure, and invented the mercury barometer. This was a milestone in experimental physics.

statement.zh:
意大利物理学家埃万杰利斯塔·托里拆利将装有水银的长玻璃管倒插入水银槽中，发现水银柱高度恒定在76厘米，证明大气压存在，并发明了水银气压计。这是实验物理学的重要里程碑。

1643年的意大利，「托里拆利发明水银气压计」属于科技领域。

summary.en: On May 14, Louis XIII died, and the 4-year-old Louis XIV ascended to the throne, with his mother Anne of Austria and Cardinal Mazarin as regents. Louis XIV later took personal control and became the exemplar of French absolute monarchy, building the Palace of Versailles. He reigned for 72 years (1643-1715), the longest of any European monarch.

title.en: Li Zicheng captures Beijing; Ming dynasty falls

summary.en: On March 19, Li Zicheng's Dashun army stormed Beijing. Emperor Chongzhen hanged himself on Coal Hill (now Jingshan Hill), ending the 276-year Ming dynasty. After entering Beijing, Li Zicheng established the Dashun regime, but he failed to govern effectively. His subordinates looted wealthy officials and nobles, losing the support of the gentry.

statement.zh: 四月，清军多铎部围攻扬州，南明督师史可法率军民坚守。城破后，清军为震慑抵抗，下令屠城十天，死亡约80万人（一说8万）。史可法被俘不屈而死。扬州十日是清军南下过程中的重大惨剧。
statement.en:
In the fourth lunar month, the Qing army under Dodo besieged Yangzhou. Ming loyalist governor Shi Kefa defended the city with the populace. After the city fell, the Qing ordered a ten-day massacre to intimidate resisters, killing about 800,000 (some sources say 80,000). Shi Kefa was captured and executed. The Yangzhou massacre was a major atrocity during the Qing conquest of southern China.

title.en: Battle of Naseby; Parliamentarian army destroys King's main force

summary.en: On June 14, Oliver Cromwell's New Model Army decisively defeated King Charles I's Royalist army at Naseby (Northamptonshire). The king fled to Scotland and surrendered the following year. This battle sealed the Parliamentarians' victory in the civil war.

title.en: Yongli Emperor enthroned in Zhaoqing; Southern Ming's last gasp

summary.en: In the eleventh lunar month, Prince Gui Zhu Youlang ascended the throne in Zhaoqing as the Yongli Emperor, the last emperor of the Southern Ming. Supported by the remnants of the Great Western Army (Sun Kewang and Li Dingguo), he held out against the Qing, briefly reconquering Hunan and Guangxi. Later he fled to Burma and was captured and killed by Wu Sangui in 1662.

statement.zh:
十一月，桂王朱由榔在肇庆称帝，年号永历，是为永历帝。他是南明最后一个皇帝，在大西军余部孙可望、李定国支持下坚持抗清，一度收复湖南、广西等地。后逃入缅甸，1662年被吴三桂俘杀。

1646年的南明，「永历帝在肇庆即位，南明苟延残喘」属于政治领域。
statement.en: In the eleventh lunar month, Prince Gui Zhu Youlang ascended the throne in Zhaoqing as the Yongli Emperor, the last emperor of the Southern Ming.

title.en: Ashmolean Museum founded at Oxford; first university museum

summary.en: English collector Elias Ashmole donated his collection to Oxford University, which used it to establish the Ashmolean Museum of Art and Archaeology. It was the world's first university museum and an important step in public education.

statement.zh: 英国收藏家伊莱亚斯·阿什莫尔将其藏品捐赠牛津大学，大学据此建立阿什莫林艺术与考古博物馆。这是世界上第一座大学博物馆，对公共教育有重要意义。藏品含手稿、钱币、标本与珍玩，最初附设于大学的实验与收藏空间；向公众与学者开放，使私人收藏转为教学与研究的资源。

title.en: Tsar Alexis issues the 'Sobornoye Ulozheniye' (Legal Code)

summary.en: Tsar Alexis Mikhailovich issued the 'Sobornoye Ulozheniye', the first printed complete legal code in Russia. It established the legal framework for serfdom, binding peasants to the land, and strengthened the absolute monarchy.

title.en: Zhang Xianzhong killed in battle at Xichong

summary.en: In the first lunar month, the Qing army under Haoge attacked Sichuan. Zhang Xianzhong led his Great Western army to meet them at Fenghuang Mountain in Xichong. During the battle, Zhang was hit by a Qing arrow and died. The remnants of the Great Western army, led by Sun Kewang and Li Dingguo, later joined the Southern Ming Yongli regime and continued the anti-Qing struggle.

statement.zh:
正月，清军豪格部进攻四川，张献忠率大西军在西充凤凰山迎战。战斗中张献忠被清军流矢射中身亡。大西军余部由孙可望、李定国率领转投南明永历政权，继续抗清。

1647年的大西，「张献忠战死西充」属于军事领域。
statement.en: In the first lunar month, the Qing army under Haoge attacked Sichuan.

title.en: Qing capture Nanchang; Jiangxi pacified

summary.en: In the 6th year of Shunzhi (1649), the Qing army captured Nanchang. The Ming defector Jin Shenghuan, who had held the city and rebelled against the Qing, was besieged for months and killed when the city fell. The Qing thus gained control of Jiangxi in the middle-lower Yangtze region, while the Southern Ming regime retreated to the far southwest.

title.en: Descartes dies in Stockholm

summary.en: On February 11, French philosopher Descartes died of pneumonia in Stockholm, Sweden. He had been invited by Queen Christina to teach philosophy at her court but fell ill due to the harsh climate. His works laid the foundation for modern philosophy and mathematics.

1650年的瑞典，「笛卡尔在斯德哥尔摩去世」属于文化领域。

title.en: The Atlantic triangular trade peaks

summary.en: The Europe–Africa–Americas triangular trade peaked, cycling enslaved people, manufactures and raw goods across the oceans.

statement.zh: 欧洲—非洲—美洲间的大西洋三角贸易达于鼎盛，奴隶、制成品与原料跨洋循环。航线把欧洲制成品运往非洲，再把非洲的被迫迁移者运往美洲，返程带回原料与商品；这一循环把三大洲的经济与人口紧紧绑在一起，其代价主要由被奴役者承担。三角贸易也塑造了港口城市、航运与金融的组织方式。

title.en: Battle of Zhoushan; Qing forces destroy Southern Ming Zhang Mingzhen's forces

title.en: Southern Ming Li Dingguo wins battle of Guilin, reconquers Guangxi

summary.en: Southern Ming general Li Dingguo stormed Guilin; Qing Prince of Dingnan Kong Youde was defeated and committed suicide. Li reconquered all of Guangxi and entered Hunan, achieving one of the most brilliant victories of the Southern Ming resistance. However, subsequent infighting with Sun Kewang led to disaster.

title.en: Dutch establish colony at Cape of Good Hope

summary.en: Jan van Riebeeck of the Dutch East India Company established a permanent settlement at the Cape of Good Hope, planting vegetables and fruit to supply passing ships. The colony attracted Dutch, German, and French Huguenot immigrants, forming the Afrikaner (Boer) population of South Africa.

statement.zh:
荷兰东印度公司的扬·范·里贝克在好望角建立永久定居点，种植蔬菜和水果，为经过的船只提供补给。该殖民地逐渐吸引荷兰、德国和法国胡格诺派移民，形成了南非的阿非利卡人（布尔人）族群。

title.en: First Anglo-Dutch War breaks out

title.en: First Anglo-Dutch War ends; English victory

summary.en: In April, England and the Netherlands signed the Treaty of Westminster. The Dutch accepted England's Navigation Acts and paid war reparations. England gained an advantage in maritime trade, but the Netherlands retained its interests in the East Indies.

statement.zh: 4月，英荷签订《威斯敏斯特和约》，荷兰承认英国的《航海法案》并赔偿战争损失。英国获得了海上贸易优势，但荷兰保留了在东印度群岛的既得利益。和约使英国得以用法律限制中立国船只承运，荷兰的转口贸易受挫；两国在东方的据点仍然对峙，海上霸权之争转入新的阶段。
statement.en: In April, Britain and the Netherlands signed the Treaty of Westminster, in which the Netherlands recognized the British Navigation Act and compensated for war losses.

title.en: Hendrick Hamel Shipwrecked on Jeju

summary.en: A Dutch East India Company crew was wrecked on Jeju and held thirteen years; Hamel's escape and journal gave Europe its first detailed account of Korea.

title.en: Qing court establishes 'Thirteen Offices' to empower eunuchs

summary.en: The Shunzhi Emperor, imitating the Ming, created the 'Thirteen Offices' (neiwufu) and favored eunuchs like Wu Liangfu. This violated the Qing founding rule that eunuchs should not interfere in politics; the Kangxi Emperor abolished them after ascending.

statement.zh:
顺治帝仿明制设立内务府十三衙门，重用宦官吴良辅等。但此做法违反清太祖关于太监不得干政的祖训，康熙即位后废除。内务府与宦官系统分担宫廷财政与事务，权力集中带来弊端；祖训与制度惯例成为后来裁撤的依据。宫廷事务重归内廷管辖。

title.en: Magdeburg hemispheres experiment demonstrates atmospheric pressure

summary.en: Otto von Guericke, mayor of Magdeburg, performed the famous Magdeburg hemispheres experiment: he put two copper hemispheres together, evacuated the air, and found that sixteen horses could not pull them apart. The experiment provided visible proof of the force of atmospheric pressure.

statement.zh: 德国马德堡市长奥托·冯·格里克进行著名的马德堡半球实验：他将两个铜半球合拢并抽成真空，16匹马才将其拉开。该实验直观证明了大气压的强大力量。实验以公开表演的方式展示自然之力，两队的马匹与围观人群成为见证；真空泵的改进同样关键。大气压从此成为可感知的物理事实。

title.en: Qing court issues 'Complete Book of Taxes and Services' to regulate finances

summary.en: The Qing court compiled the 'Complete Book of Taxes and Services', standardizing tax collection and reducing burdens in some areas to restore an economy devastated by war. This was an important early-Qing measure for economic recovery.

statement.zh:
清廷编定《赋役全书》，统一税收标准，减轻部分地区负担，以恢复因战乱破坏的农业经济。这是清初恢复生产的重要措施之一。全书把田赋、丁银与徭役登记成册，作为征收依据；统一标准减少地方任意加派。财政整顿为战后复苏提供制度基础。

把「清廷颁布《赋役全书》，整顿财政」放回1654年的清，可以看到经济变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Treaty of Pereyaslav: Ukraine incorporated into Russia

summary.en: In January, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, leader of the Ukrainian Cossacks, seeking protection from Poland, concluded the Treaty of Pereyaslav with Tsar Alexis of Russia, recognizing Russian suzerainty and bringing Left-bank Ukraine into the Tsardom of Russia. This triggered the Russo-Polish War (1654-1667).

statement.zh: 1月，乌克兰哥萨克首领博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基为对抗波兰，与俄国沙皇阿列克谢签订《佩列亚斯拉夫条约》，承认俄国的保护，乌克兰左岸地区并入沙皇俄国。

title.en: Dutch astronomer Huygens discovers Titan (Saturn's moon)

summary.en: Christiaan Huygens, using a self-built telescope, discovered Saturn's largest moon, Titan, and also identified Saturn's ring system. He later invented the pendulum clock.

statement.zh:
克里斯蒂安·惠更斯用自制的望远镜发现土星最大的卫星——土卫六，并确认土星有环状结构。他后来发明了摆钟。观测依靠自制镜片与细致的绘图，环的确认纠正了此前把环看作卫星的误解；摆钟则以摆的等时性提高计时精度。

把「荷兰天文学家惠更斯发现土卫六（泰坦）」放回1655年的荷兰，可以看到科技变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Qing court establishes 'Grand Secretariat' to replace the Three Inner Courts

summary.en: The Shunzhi Emperor reorganized the Three Inner Courts (National History, Secretarial, and Literary) into a Grand Secretariat, modeled on the Ming grand secretaries, marking further sinicization of the central administration.

statement.zh:
顺治帝改内三院（内国史院、内秘书院、内弘文院）为内阁，仿明制大学士制度，标志着清朝中枢机构进一步汉化。内阁掌票拟与文书，大学士由满汉官员充任，中枢决策仍受议政王大臣会议牵制；制度调整使政务运转更接近明制。

把「清廷设置“内阁”取代内三院」放回1656年的清，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Velázquez paints 'Las Meninas'

summary.en: Diego Velázquez completed the oil painting 'Las Meninas' ('The Maids of Honor'), depicting the Infanta Margaret Theresa of Spain in the presence of her maids of honor, with the painter himself appearing in the scene. The complex perspective and ambiguity between reality and illusion make it one of the greatest masterpieces of Western art.

statement.zh:
迭戈·委拉斯开兹完成油画《宫娥》（Las Meninas），画中描绘西班牙菲利普四世的小公主玛格丽特在宫娥陪伴下的场景，画家本人也出现在画中。这幅画以其复杂的透视和模糊的真实与幻觉边界成为西方艺术史上的杰作。

1656年的西班牙，「西班牙画家委拉斯开兹创作《宫娥》」属于艺术领域。

title.en: Sun Kewang defects to Qing, intensifying Southern Ming infighting

summary.en: Sun Kewang, the 'Prince of Qin' in the Southern Ming, jealous of Li Dingguo's achievements, attacked him. After being defeated, Sun defected to the Qing, revealing Southern Ming military secrets and guiding Qing forces into the southwest. This hastened the fall of the Southern Ming.

statement.zh:
南明秦王孙可望因嫉妒李定国的功绩，率军进攻李定国，战败后投降清朝。孙可望将南明虚实告知清廷，并引清军入西南。南明失去重要屏障，加速了灭亡。

title.en: Huygens invents pendulum clock, improving timekeeping accuracy

summary.en: Christiaan Huygens, applying Galileo's principle of isochronism of the pendulum, designed and built the first pendulum clock. The error was reduced from 15 minutes per day to about 1 minute, greatly aiding scientific experiments and navigation.

statement.zh: 克里斯蒂安·惠更斯根据伽利略的摆的等时性原理，设计并制造了第一台摆钟。摆钟的误差从每天15分钟缩小到1分钟，极大促进了科学实验和航海定位的精确性。他以摆锤与擒纵机构控制齿轮，使时间计量摆脱了重锤与滴漏的粗疏；钟表匠据此改良工艺，计时器成为观测与航海的工具。
statement.en: Christian Huygens designed and built the first pendulum clock based on Galileo's principle of isochronism of the pendulum.

title.en: English East India Company establishes trading post in Calcutta

summary.en: The English East India Company obtained permission from Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb to establish a trading post on the Hooghly River in Bengal, which later developed into the city of Calcutta. Calcutta became the capital of British India (until 1911).

statement.zh: 英国东印度公司获得莫卧儿皇帝奥朗则布的许可，在孟加拉胡格利河畔建立商馆，后发展为加尔各答市。加尔各答成为英属印度的首府（直到1911年）。商馆以货物仓储、关税豁免与地方贸易为业，公司借此深入孟加拉的丝绸与硝石生意；河口的位置便于舰队与商船停泊。

title.en: Cromwell dies; Protectorate collapses

summary.en: On September 3, Oliver Cromwell died at Whitehall, London. His son Richard Cromwell succeeded as Lord Protector but lacked political and military ability; he was forced to resign the following year, plunging England into chaos and paving the way for the restoration of the monarchy.

title.en: Aurangzeb usurps the throne, becoming Mughal emperor

summary.en: When Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan fell seriously ill, his son Aurangzeb staged a coup, defeated his elder brother Dara Shikoh, and imprisoned his father in Agra Fort. Aurangzeb proclaimed himself emperor under the title 'Alamgir' (World Seizer). He enforced Islamic law and religious persecution, leading to the empire's decline.

title.en: Qing forces capture Kunming; Yongli Emperor flees to Burma

summary.en: Qing armies advanced into Yunnan from three directions. The Southern Ming Yongli Emperor, escorted by Li Dingguo, fled from Kunming to Burma. The Burmese king first accepted him but later, under Qing pressure, handed him over.

statement.zh:
清军三路进攻云南，南明永历帝在李定国保护下从昆明逃往缅甸避难。缅甸国王最初接纳，后被清军压力逼迫交出永历帝。流亡朝廷失去财赋与兵源，边境土司的态度决定去路；入缅后的安置与监视使复国希望日渐渺茫。边地治理转向久驻。

把「清军攻占昆明，南明永历帝出逃缅甸」放回1658年的清，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Treaty of the Pyrenees signed; France becomes dominant European power

summary.en: On November 7, France and Spain signed the Treaty of the Pyrenees on Pheasant Island in the Pyrenees, ending the Franco-Spanish War (1635-1659). France gained Artois, Roussillon, and other territories, and Louis XIV married the Spanish Infanta Maria Theresa. France replaced Spain as the foremost European power.

title.en: Zheng Chenggong's northern expedition fails at Nanjing

summary.en: In the seventh lunar month, Zheng Chenggong led an army of 100,000 with 3,000 ships on a northern expedition, besieging Nanjing. Due to overconfidence and tactical errors, he was counterattacked by Qing forces and suffered a major defeat, retreating to Xiamen. The failure ended his last chance to retake the mainland, and he turned his attention to Taiwan as a base.

statement.zh:
七月，郑成功率10万大军、3000艘船北伐，包围南京。但因轻敌和战术失误，遭清军反击大败，退守厦门。北伐失败使郑成功失去反攻大陆的最后机会，转而已台湾为基地。

summary.en: In March, Cardinal Mazarin died. The 23-year-old Louis XIV announced that he would not appoint a chief minister and would rule personally. He proclaimed 'L'État, c'est moi' ('I am the state'), centralized authority, built the Palace of Versailles, and controlled the nobility.

summary.en: On April 30, Zheng Chenggong (Koxinga) led 25,000 troops and 300 ships across the Taiwan Strait, landing at Luermen. title.en: Boyle publishes The Sceptical Chymist

summary.en: Robert Boyle published 'The Sceptical Chymist', using experiment to criticise the four elements and arguing that elements are irreducible substances, founding modern chemistry.

statement.zh:
罗伯特·波义耳出版《怀疑派化学家》，以实验批判四元素说，并主张元素为不可再分物质。批判旧说与提出新定义是同一工作的两面：否定四元素说之后，必须给出可操作的“元素”概念，化学才有独立的研究对象。由此该书被视为奠基近代化学的著作。

把「波义耳出版《怀疑派化学家》」放回1661年的英国，可以看到科学变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Robert Hooke discovers cells

summary.en: English scientist Robert Hooke, using a self-made microscope, observed thin slices of cork and saw many small compartments, which he named 'cells'. He published 'Micrographia', inaugurating cell biology.

statement.zh:
英国科学家罗伯特·胡克用自制的显微镜观察软木切片，发现许多蜂窝状小室，命名为“细胞”（cell）。命名把观察到的空腔固定为一个可继续研究的概念；随后发表的《显微图谱》使这些观察进入公共知识，从而被视为开创细胞生物学。

title.en: Zheng Chenggong dies; Zheng Jing inherits Taiwan regime

summary.en: On June 23, Zheng Chenggong, learning of the Yongli Emperor's death and of his son Zheng Jing's affair with a wet nurse, died suddenly in Taiwan at age 38. His son Zheng Jing came from Xiamen to succeed him and maintained the Zheng regime.

statement.zh:
6月23日，郑成功因得知永历帝被杀、儿子郑经与乳母私通等打击，在台湾急病去世，年仅38岁。其子郑经自厦门赴台继位，维持明郑政权。

title.en: Boyle formulates gas law

summary.en: The Irish natural philosopher Robert Boyle argued in 'The Sceptical Chymist' (1661) for an experiment-based chemistry and in 1662 used an air pump to show that, at fixed temperature, the volume of a given gas is inversely proportional to its pressure (Boyle's law), founding modern gas mechanics.

statement.zh: 爱尔兰自然哲学家罗伯特·玻意耳在《怀疑的化学家》（1661）倡导以实验为本的化学，并于1662年以空气泵实验表明一定量气体在定温下体积与压强成反比（玻意耳定律），奠基近代气体力学。

title.en: Ottoman Empire defeats Holy League, captures Uyvar

title.en: English establish Carolina colony

title.en: Molière's 'Tartuffe' premieres

summary.en: French playwright Molière's satirical comedy 'Tartuffe' premiered at the Palace of Versailles, exposing religious hypocrisy. Due to strong opposition from the Church, the play was banned for five years, becoming one of the most controversial works in literary history.

statement.zh:
法国剧作家莫里哀（让-巴蒂斯特·波克兰）的讽刺喜剧《伪君子》（Tartuffe）在凡尔赛宫首演，揭露宗教伪善者。因教会强烈反对，该剧被禁演五年，成为文学史上最受争议的作品之一。

1664年的法国，「莫里哀喜剧《伪君子》首演」属于文学领域。

title.en: Qing pacifies 'Thirteen Families' in eastern Sichuan, basically unifies south China

summary.en: The Qing army destroyed the anti-Qing 'Thirteen Families of Kuidong' led by Li Laiheng. With this, large-scale resistance in southern China was basically ended. The Qing had completed unification of China except for Taiwan.

statement.zh:
清军攻灭川东的抗清武装“夔东十三家”（李来亨等），至此南方大规模反抗基本平息。清朝完成了除台湾外的全国统一。山地的堡寨与联营依托地形持久抵抗，清军以分路围困与招降瓦解；战后州县重建、户籍与垦荒同步推进。南方由此底定。

title.en: English capture New Amsterdam, rename it New York

title.en: Great Plague of London, about 100,000 die

summary.en: In the spring, bubonic plague broke out in London; by year's end, about 100,000 had died (one quarter of the city's population). The rich fled, and King Charles II moved his court to Oxford. The plague was the last great disaster before the Great Fire of London in 1666.

statement.zh: 春季，腺鼠疫在伦敦爆发，至年底约10万人死亡，占伦敦人口四分之一。死亡规模之外，富人逃离与国王查理二世迁往牛津，说明瘟疫同时冲击了城市的社会结构与权力中心；人口密集、卫生条件与救治能力都在其中起作用。大瘟疫因此被视为1666年伦敦大火前的最后一场大灾难。

title.en: Lunda Empire rises

title.en: France and the Netherlands ally against England

title.en: The Eastern Qing tombs are begun

summary.en: The Qing began the Eastern Tombs at Changrui Mountain in Zunhua, Hebei, burying emperors Shunzhi, Kangxi, Qianlong and others in a vast imperial necropolis.

statement.zh:
清廷在河北遵化昌瑞山建东陵，葬顺治、康熙、乾隆等帝后，是规模宏大的清代皇家陵寝。陵区依山势展开，以孝陵为中心，各陵沿轴线分列，神道、石像生与隆恩殿表现礼制等级。此后西陵另设，两陵区形成东西对应的格局。

把「清东陵始建」放回1666年的清，可以看到建筑变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Great Fire of London destroys most of the city center

summary.en: From September 2 to 6, a fire that started in a bakery on Pudding Lane spread across London, destroying about 13,200 houses and 87 churches (including old St Paul's Cathedral), but only six deaths were reported. title.en: Kangxi Emperor marries Empress Heseri

summary.en: The 12-year-old Kangxi Emperor married the granddaughter of regent Sonin, Heseri, marking his gradual liberation from the regents. Empress Heseri later gave birth to Crown Prince Yinreng.

statement.zh:
12岁康熙帝与辅政大臣索尼的孙女赫舍里氏大婚，标志着康熙开始逐步摆脱辅臣控制。皇后赫舍里氏后来生下太子胤礽。婚事由祖母孝庄太后主持，以联姻争取索尼一系的支持；宫廷权力在辅臣之间重新分配。少年天子的亲政由此起步。

把「康熙帝大婚，娶赫舍里氏为皇后」放回1666年的清，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。

summary.en: On 30 January 1667 the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth and Russia signed a truce of thirteen and a half years at the village of Andrusovo near Smolensk, ending the thirteen-year war that had begun in 1654 over the allegiance of the Ukrainian Cossacks. statement.zh: 1667年1月30日，波兰立陶宛联邦与俄国在斯摩棱斯克附近的安德鲁索沃村签订为期十三年半的停战协定，结束了自1654年因乌克兰哥萨克归附问题爆发的十三年战争。波兰放弃斯摩棱斯克、切尔尼戈夫与第聂伯河左岸乌克兰，基辅名义上暂交俄国两年，实则再未归还，1686年《永久和约》正式追认。协定未与哥萨克方面协商即沿第聂伯河瓜分乌克兰。激起赫特曼国的分裂与长达数十年的"废墟时代"内战；联邦经此役与"大洪水"重创元气，俄国则取而代之成为东欧的主导力量。

title.en: War of Devolution: France invades the Spanish Netherlands

summary.en: Louis XIV, claiming the 'right of devolution' through his wife Maria Theresa (Spanish princess), invaded the Spanish Netherlands (present-day Belgium). The French captured several cities but, under pressure from the Triple Alliance of England, the Netherlands, and Sweden, signed the Treaty of Aachen (Aix-la-Chapelle), gaining some territory.

statement.zh:

title.en: Dutch painter Vermeer dies, leaving 'Girl with a Pearl Earring'

title.en: Secret Treaty of Dover signed; England secretly promises to support France

summary.en: In May, Charles II and Louis XIV signed the secret Treaty of Dover. England promised to help France against the Netherlands and to restore Catholicism in England (the king secretly converting), while France provided financial support. The treaty was the background to the Third Anglo-Dutch War.

title.en: Spinoza's Ethics

summary.en: Spinoza wrote the 'Ethics' in geometric order, arguing for a single substance (God or Nature) and determinism, deeply influencing the Enlightenment and German idealism.

statement.zh:
斯宾诺莎以几何体例写《伦理学》，论证一元实体（神即自然）与决定论，深刻影响启蒙与德国观念论。全书按定义、公理与命题推演，把情感与自由纳入必然性的框架，主张认识必然即得自由。著作在生前未具名刊行，后来成为泛神论与理性主义讨论的起点。

title.en: Wu Sangui actively prepares for rebellion in Yunnan

summary.en: Wu Sangui, Prince of Pingxi, trained troops, stockpiled grain, and even minted his own coins in Yunnan. His growing power alarmed the Qing court, setting the stage for the Revolt of the Three Feudatories in 1673.

statement.zh:

title.en: Molière's 'The Bourgeois Gentleman' premieres

summary.en: Molière's comédie-ballet 'Le Bourgeois Gentilhomme' premiered at the Château de Chambord, satirizing a wealthy commoner trying to rise into the nobility. Incorporating Turkish ceremonial dance, it is one of Molière's late masterpieces.

title.en: Peter the Great born

summary.en: The Russian tsar Peter I (1672-1725) came to the throne as a child and later imposed westernising reforms and built St Petersburg, making Russia a European power.

statement.zh:
俄国沙皇彼得一世（1672—1725）幼年即位，日后推行西化改革、建新都圣彼得堡，使俄国跻身欧洲强国。他在宫廷政争中成长，亲政后以军事、行政与教育改造国家，并向外寻求出海口；其改革深刻改变俄国的制度与面貌。

把「彼得大帝出生」放回1672年的俄罗斯，可以看到人物变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Franco-Dutch War breaks out; Louis XIV invades the Netherlands

summary.en: In April, France, allied with England and Cologne, attacked the Dutch Republic. French forces rapidly overran much of the Netherlands. The Dutch opened the dikes and flooded the land, stopping the French advance on Amsterdam. The Dutch navy under Tromp repeatedly defeated the combined Anglo-French fleet.

statement.zh:
4月，法国联合英国、科隆等盟国进攻荷兰共和国。法军迅速占领荷兰大片领土，荷兰人决堤放水淹没国土，阻止法军进占阿姆斯特丹。荷兰海军在特罗普指挥下多次击败英法联合舰队。

1672年的法国，「法荷战争爆发，路易十四入侵荷兰」属于军事领域。

title.en: Newton submits paper on light and color to Royal Society

summary.en: Newton's paper proposed a particle theory of light and demonstrated that white light is composed of different colors. His conclusions were harshly criticized by Hooke, causing Newton to withhold his optical works for many years.

statement.zh:
牛顿在论文中提出光的粒子说，并论证白光由不同颜色的光混合而成。他的观点遭到胡克的强烈批评，导致牛顿多年不愿发表光学著作。棱镜实验把白光分解为色带，粒子说与波动说由此争论；学术争论影响发表选择。光学研究在争议中推进。

把「牛顿向皇家学会提交关于光和颜色的论文」放回1672年的英格兰，可以看到科技变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Qing court abolishes land confiscation (quan di) to ease Manchu-Han tensions

summary.en: The Kangxi Emperor ordered a halt to the practice of Manchu nobles seizing Han land (quan di), which had displaced many peasants. The move helped social stability and economic recovery.

statement.zh:
康熙帝下令停止满族贵族圈占汉人土地的“圈地令”，此前圈地导致大量农民失地流亡。此举有助于社会安定和恢复生产。旗地、庄田与民田的界限在诏令后逐步厘清，逃人法与垦荒政策随之调整；地方吏治仍决定执行成效，旗人生计与民人产权需长期调处。

把「清廷废除圈地令，缓和满汉矛盾」放回1672年的清，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Leibniz introduces modern calculus notation

summary.en: German mathematician Gottfried Leibniz, independently of Newton, developed calculus and introduced the integral sign ∫ and the differential symbol d. His notation is still used today. His priority dispute with Newton lasted his entire life.

title.en: Revolt of the Three Feudatories breaks out; Wu Sangui rebels

summary.en: In the 11th lunar month, the Kangxi Emperor ordered the abolition of the three feudatories. Wu Sangui in Yunnan rose in rebellion, proclaiming himself 'Grand Marshal of the Supreme Command'. Soon Geng Jingzhong (Jingnan feudatory) and Shang Zhixin (Pingnan feudatory) joined. The revolt engulfed several southern provinces, and the Qing court was in serious danger.

statement.zh: 11月，康熙帝下令撤藩，平西王吴三桂在云南起兵反清，自称“天下都招讨兵马大元帅”。随后靖南王耿精忠、平南王尚之信响应。叛乱席卷南方数省，清廷一度处境危急。
statement.en:
In the 11th lunar month, the Kangxi Emperor ordered the abolition of the three feudatories. Wu Sangui in Yunnan rose in rebellion, proclaiming himself 'Grand Marshal of the Supreme Command'. Soon Geng Jingzhong (Jingnan feudatory) and Shang Zhixin (Pingnan feudatory) joined. The revolt engulfed several southern provinces, and the Qing court was in serious danger.

For Asia in 1673, “Revolt of the Three Feudatories breaks out; Wu Sangui rebels” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.en: Geng Jingzhong in Fujian and Shang Zhixin in Guangdong successively rebelled against the Qing and joined Wu Sangui. Their combined forces once occupied Zhejiang, Jiangxi, and other provinces, reaching the peak of the feudatories' power. However, Geng later surrendered to the Qing due to a conflict with Zheng Jing.

title.en: Shivaji crowned Emperor of the Maratha Empire

summary.en: Indian Maratha leader Shivaji was crowned 'Chhatrapati' (emperor) at Raigad Fort, founding the Maratha Empire. He employed guerrilla tactics to seize large territory from the Mughals and became a symbol of Hindu resistance to Islamic Mughal rule.

statement.zh:
印度马拉塔领袖希瓦吉在赖加德城堡加冕为“贾特拉帕蒂”（Chhatrapati），建立马拉塔帝国。他推行游击战术，从莫卧儿帝国手中夺取大片领土，成为印度教反抗伊斯兰莫卧儿统治的旗帜。

1674年的马拉塔帝国，「希瓦吉加冕为马拉塔帝国皇帝」属于政治领域。

title.en: Maratha Kingdom founded

title.en: England signs Treaty of Westminster, withdraws from Franco-Dutch War

summary.en: In February, England and the Netherlands made a separate peace, ending the Third Anglo-Dutch War. England returned to the status quo ante, while the Netherlands ceded New Netherland (New York) to England. England thereafter opposed the Netherlands no more and instead turned to containing France.

title.en: King Philip's War: New England colonists vs. Native Americans

summary.en: Wampanoag chief Metacomet (called 'King Philip') led a coalition of tribes in attacks on New England settlements. The war lasted until 1676, with heavy casualties on both sides. The Native Americans were ultimately defeated and lost much of their land.

statement.zh: 万帕诺亚格人酋长梅塔科梅特（称“菲力浦王”）联合多个部落，袭击新英格兰殖民点。战争持续至1676年，双方伤亡惨重，印第安人最终失败，失去大片土地。
statement.en:
Wampanoag chief Metacomet (called 'King Philip') led a coalition of tribes in attacks on New England settlements. The war lasted until 1676, with heavy casualties on both sides. The Native Americans were ultimately defeated and lost much of their land.

For North America in 1675, “King Philip's War: New England colonists vs. Native Americans” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Leeuwenhoek observes microorganisms for the first time

summary.en: Dutch scientist Antonie van Leeuwenhoek, using a self-made single-lens microscope, observed rainwater and scrapings from his teeth and found 'microorganisms' (protozoa and bacteria). He reported his findings to the Royal Society, ushering in microbiology.

statement.zh: 荷兰科学家安东尼·范·列文虎克用自制的单透镜显微镜观察雨水和牙垢，发现了“微生物”（原生动物和细菌）。他向皇家学会报告这一发现，开启了微生物学。镜片由他自行研磨，放大倍数远超前人；他反复描述微小生物的游动与形态，并请人见证。皇家学会的通讯使这一发现传遍欧洲学界。
statement.en: Dutch scientist Antoni van Leeuwenhoek used a homemade single-lens microscope to observe rainwater and tartar and discovered "microorganisms" (protozoa and bacteria).

title.en: Denmark and Netherlands form alliance against Sweden

title.en: Stepan Razin rebellion in Russia suppressed

summary.en: The rebellion of Cossack leader Stepan Razin against serfdom and the tsarist autocracy was crushed. Razin was executed in Moscow. It was the largest peasant war in 17th-century Russia.

title.en: Qing recover Jiangxi and Zhejiang; tide turns in Three Feudatories War

summary.en: In the 15th year of Kangxi (1676), the Qing army achieved major victories in Jiangxi and Zhejiang. Geng Jingzhong surrendered under Qing pressure, and Zheng Jing's forces were driven out of Fujian. The Revolt of the Three Feudatories entered a phase of Qing counteroffensive; Wu Sangui was trapped in Hunan and unable to advance north.

statement.zh: 清康熙15年（1676年），清军在江西和浙江战场取得重大胜利。耿精忠在清军压力下投降，郑经的军队被逐出福建。三藩之乱开始转入清军全面反攻阶段，吴三桂困守湖南已无力北进。
statement.en:
In the 15th year of Kangxi (1676), the Qing army achieved major victories in Jiangxi and Zhejiang. Geng Jingzhong surrendered under Qing pressure, and Zheng Jing's forces were driven out of Fujian. The Revolt of the Three Feudatories entered a phase of Qing counteroffensive; Wu Sangui was trapped in Hunan and unable to advance north.

For Asia in 1676, “Qing recover Jiangxi and Zhejiang; tide turns in Three Feudatories War” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Baruch Spinoza dies; 'Ethics' published posthumously

summary.en: Dutch philosopher Spinoza died in The Hague; his 'Ethics' was published that same year. The book, written in geometric style, argues that God and nature are one (pantheism), profoundly influencing later philosophy.

statement.zh:
荷兰哲学家斯宾诺莎在海牙去世，同年他的《伦理学》出版。该书以几何学方法论证上帝、自然和心灵的关系，提出“上帝即自然”的泛神论，对后世哲学影响深远。

1677年的荷兰，「巴鲁赫·斯宾诺莎去世，发表《伦理学》」属于文化领域。
statement.en: The Dutch philosopher Spinoza died in The Hague, the same year his Ethics was published.

title.en: Qing recover Hunan; Wu Sangui retreats to Yunnan-Guizhou

summary.en: In the 16th year of Kangxi (1677), Qing forces made major gains against Wu Sangui. Important cities in northern Hunan such as Yuezhou (now Yueyang) and Changsha were recovered. Wu Sangui was forced to abandon his Hunan base and retreated to Guizhou and Yunnan. The Qing pursued with a policy of divide and rule. Wu Sangui died of illness in 1678 after proclaiming himself emperor

statement.zh: 清康熙16年（1677年），清军在与吴三桂叛军的战争中取得重大胜利。岳州（今岳阳）、长沙等湘北重镇被清军收复。吴三桂被迫放弃经营多年的湖南根据地，率部退守贵州和云南。清军乘胜追击，实施了分化瓦解政策。吴三桂于1678年在衡州称帝后病死，叛军士气低落，三藩之乱进入最后阶段。
statement.en:
In the 16th year of Kangxi (1677), Qing forces made major gains against Wu Sangui. Important cities in northern Hunan such as Yuezhou (now Yueyang) and Changsha were recovered. Wu Sangui was forced to abandon his Hunan base and retreated to Guizhou and Yunnan. The Qing pursued with a policy of divide and rule. Wu Sangui died of illness in 1678 after proclaiming himself emperor at Hengzhou; morale among the rebels collapsed, and the Three Feudatories War entered its final phase.

For Asia in 1677, “Qing recover Hunan; Wu Sangui retreats to Yunnan-Guizhou” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Wu Sangui declares himself emperor, then dies

summary.en: In the 17th year of Kangxi (1678), Wu Sangui proclaimed himself emperor of the Great Zhou state at Hengzhou, Hunan, with the reign title Zhaowu. But he was already gravely ill and died in August. His grandson Wu Shifan succeeded and retreated to Yunnan. The rebellion quickly collapsed.

statement.zh:
清康熙17年（1678年）三月，吴三桂在湖南衡州（今衡阳）称帝，国号大周，年号昭武。但他已病入膏肓，同年八月病逝。其孙吴世璠继位后退守云南，三藩之乱迅速走向失败。

1678年的大周，「吴三桂称帝，旋即病死」属于政治领域。
statement.en:
In the 17th year of Kangxi (1678), Wu Sangui proclaimed himself emperor of the Great Zhou state at Hengzhou, Hunan, with the reign title Zhaowu. But he was already gravely ill and died in August. His grandson Wu Shifan succeeded and retreated to Yunnan. The rebellion quickly collapsed. In 1678, “Wu Sangui declares himself emperor, then dies” belongs to the field of Politics in Asia. The record is presented as part of the wider history of Great Zhou rather than as an isolated incident.

title.en: John Bunyan publishes 'The Pilgrim's Progress'

summary.en: English writer John Bunyan wrote 'The Pilgrim's Progress' while in prison; it is an allegory of a Christian's journey from the 'City of Destruction' to the 'Celestial City'. A classic of Puritan literature, it became the second most-bought book after the Bible for many years.

statement.zh: 英国作家约翰·班扬在狱中写成《天路历程》，以寓言形式描写基督徒从“毁灭之城”前往“天国”的旅程。该书是清教徒文学代表作，仅次于《圣经》的畅销书。叙事以梦境展开，人物以德性与恶习命名，路途的险阻对应信仰的考验；通俗的语言使神学走入寻常读者。它成为英语寓言的典范。

title.en: Sangpyeong Tongbo Becomes Common Currency

summary.en: King Sukjong ordered nationwide minting of copper cash, giving Korea its first durable money economy in place of grain and cloth.

statement.zh: 肃宗下令全国铸行常平通宝，铜钱首次在半岛稳定流通，实物税与米布交易逐步让位于货币经济。钱币由中央统一铸造，设有官署管理，成色与重量趋于一致；货币流通便利了税收、市场与军需，也促使物价与借贷关系发生变化。从实物到货币的转变不是一蹴而就，但常平通宝的推行是关键一步。
statement.en: Suzong ordered Changping Tongbao to be minted nationwide.

title.en: Huygens proposes wave theory of light

summary.en: In 1678 the Dutch scholar Christiaan Huygens publishes Treatise on Light, proposing the wavefront principle (Huygens’ principle) to explain the propagation and refraction of light and arguing that light is a wave rather than a stream of particles; he also invented the pendulum-controlled clock, advancing precise timekeeping.

statement.zh:
1678年，荷兰学者克里斯蒂安·惠更斯发表《光论》，提出波前原理（惠更斯原理）以解释光的传播与折射，主张光是一种波而非粒子；他还发明了以摆控制的机械钟，推动精密计时。

1678年的荷兰，「惠更斯提出光波动说」属于科学领域。

title.en: English Parliament passes Habeas Corpus Act

summary.en: In May, the English Parliament passed the Habeas Corpus Act, stipulating that no person may be imprisoned without trial and that any detainee may demand to be released (the writ of habeas corpus). This became a cornerstone of the English constitution.

statement.zh: 5月，英国议会通过《人身保护法》（Habeas Corpus Act），规定未经法庭审判不得拘禁任何人，并保障被拘禁者要求释放的权利。这是英国宪法的重要基石。

statement.zh: 清康熙18年（1679年），清军在四川战场取得决定性胜利。岳乐、图海等率军攻占了重庆和成都。吴三桂已于1678年在衡州病死，其孙吴世璠退守昆明。清军采取分化瓦解策略，赦免投诚者并给予优待。三藩之乱的南方和西部战线基本平定，清军开始向吴世璠的最后一个据点昆明合围。
statement.en:
In the 18th year of Kangxi (1679), the Qing army won decisive victories in Sichuan. Generals Yue Le and Tuhai led forces that captured Chongqing and Chengdu. After Wu Sangui's death, his grandson Wu Shifan retreated to Kunming. The Qing adopted a strategy of granting amnesty to those who surrendered. The southern and western fronts of the rebellion were basically pacified; the Qing began to concentrate on the last remaining rebel stronghold, Kunming.

For Asia in 1679, “Qing capture Chengdu and Chongqing; Three Feudatories War nears end” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Kangxi Emperor holds the Boxue Hongru examination to win over Han scholars

summary.en: In the third month of 1679 (the 18th year of Kangxi), to win over the Han literati, the Kangxi Emperor held the Boxue Hongru special examination at the Tiren Pavilion in the capital. More than 140 scholars recommended by the provinces sat the exam; fifty of them, among them Peng Sunyu, Zhu Yizun and Mao Qiling, were selected, appointed to the Hanlin Academy and set to work on t

statement.zh: 清康熙18年（1679年）三月，康熙帝为笼络汉族士人，在京师体仁阁举行博学鸿儒科考试。各省荐举征召的学者一百四十余人应试，录取彭孙遹、朱彝尊、毛奇龄等五十人，授翰林院官职并参与纂修《明史》。此举缓和了满汉矛盾，也把一批明遗民学者纳入清朝体制。
statement.en:
In the third month of 1679 (the 18th year of Kangxi), to win over the Han literati, the Kangxi Emperor held the Boxue Hongru special examination at the Tiren Pavilion in the capital. More than 140 scholars recommended by the provinces sat the exam; fifty of them, among them Peng Sunyu, Zhu Yizun and Mao Qiling, were selected, appointed to the Hanlin Academy and set to work on the History of the Ming. The measure eased Manchu-Han tensions and drew many Ming loyalist scholars into the Qing establishment.

For Asia in 1679, “Kangxi Emperor holds the Boxue Hongru examination to win over Han scholars” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Gottfried Leibniz invents binary system

summary.en: Leibniz published a paper systematically explaining binary (using only 0 and 1) and noted its similarity to the hexagrams of the I Ching. Binary is the mathematical foundation of modern computing.

title.en: Qing painted enamel (falangcai) rises

summary.en: European painted-enamel technique reached China via missionaries; the Qing imperial workshop fired falangcai porcelain with fine enamels blending Chinese and Western motifs.

statement.zh: 欧洲画珐琅技法经传教士传入，清宫造办处烧造珐琅彩瓷，釉彩细腻、题材中西合璧。画珐琅以金属或瓷胎为底，多次烧制，色彩细腻而层次丰富；清宫把西洋技法与中式题材结合，产品多为御用，体现宫廷对异域工艺的吸收与改造。珐琅彩的制作也推动了清代彩瓷的技术与审美变化。
statement.en: European enamel painting techniques were introduced by missionaries, and the Qing Palace Manufacturing Office fired enamel-colored porcelain with delicate glaze colors and a combination of Chinese and Western themes.

title.en: Hall of Mirrors built at Palace of Versailles

title.en: Qing recover Fujian and Guangdong; Zheng Jing retreats to Taiwan

summary.en: In the 19th year of Kangxi (1680), the Qing army achieved a decisive victory off the coast of Fujian, capturing Xiamen and Jinmen held by Zheng Jing. statement.zh: 清康熙19年（1680年），清军在福建沿海取得决定性胜利，攻占了郑经集团据守的厦门和金门。郑经率残部撤回台湾，沿海岛屿均被清军控制。清廷随即实行"迁界令"（海禁），将沿海居民内迁30里，以断绝台湾郑氏政权的物资来源。郑经于1681年去世，其子郑克塽继位。1683年施琅率清军攻占台湾。
statement.en:
In the 19th year of Kangxi (1680), the Qing army achieved a decisive victory off the coast of Fujian, capturing Xiamen and Jinmen held by Zheng Jing. Zheng Jing withdrew to Taiwan, and all coastal islands came under Qing control. The Qing then implemented the 'coastal evacuation' order, moving residents 30 li inland to cut off supplies to Zheng. Zheng Jing died in 1681, succeeded by his son Zheng Keshuang. In 1683, Shi Lang led a Qing fleet to take Taiwan.

For Asia in 1680, “Qing recover Fujian and Guangdong; Zheng Jing retreats to Taiwan” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

Zheng Jing withdrew to Taiwan, and all coastal islands came under Qing control. The Qing then implemented the 'coastal evacuation' order, moving residents 30 li inland to cut off supplies to Zheng. Zheng Jing died in 1681, succeeded by his son Zheng Keshuang. In 1683, Shi Lang led a Qing fleet to take Taiwan.

title.en: Pueblo Revolt: Native Americans drive out Spanish colonists

title.en: Kangxi Emperor begins first eastern inspection tour, examines northeastern border

summary.en: In the 21st year of Kangxi (1682), the Kangxi Emperor made his first eastern inspection tour. He visited Mukden (Shenyang) to pay homage to the ancestors and inspected Jilin Ula (present-day Jilin City) to assess border defenses. This reconnaissance prepared him for the later Sino-Russian conflict at Albazin.

title.en: French court formally moves to Palace of Versailles

summary.en: Louis XIV ordered the entire royal family and the main government agencies to move to Versailles, forcing the nobility to live near him and thereby weakening their local power. Versailles became the center of French politics and the model for European courts.

statement.zh:
路易十四下令将整个王室和主要政府机构迁往凡尔赛宫，将贵族集中在身边，削弱其地方势力。凡尔赛成为法国政治中心，也是欧洲宫廷效仿的典范。

1682年的法国，「法国宫廷正式迁往凡尔赛宫」属于政治领域。

title.en: Battle of Vienna; Ottoman Empire suffers crushing defeat

summary.en: On September 12, King John III Sobieski of Poland led a European relief force that defeated the Ottoman army besieging Vienna. The battle halted Ottoman expansion into central Europe and marked the beginning of Ottoman decline.

title.en: Qing forces take Taiwan; Zheng Keshuang surrenders

summary.en: In the seventh lunar month, Shi Lang's Qing naval forces captured Penghu. Zheng Keshuang (Koxinga's grandson) submitted and surrendered. The Qing incorporated Taiwan into its territory, establishing Taiwan Prefecture under Fujian Province. The Zheng regime era in Taiwan came to an end.

statement.zh: 七月，施琅率清军水师攻占澎湖，明郑郑克塽（郑成功之孙）上表投降。清朝将台湾纳入版图，设立台湾府，隶属福建省。台湾结束明郑时期。
statement.en:
In the seventh lunar month, Shi Lang's Qing naval forces captured Penghu. Zheng Keshuang (Koxinga's grandson) submitted and surrendered. The Qing incorporated Taiwan into its territory, establishing Taiwan Prefecture under Fujian Province. The Zheng regime era in Taiwan came to an end.

For Asia in 1683, “Qing forces take Taiwan; Zheng Keshuang surrenders” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: France and Holy Roman Empire sign Truce of Regensburg

summary.en: France and the Habsburgs temporarily ceased hostilities; France consolidated its gains in Alsace and Lorraine. Louis XIV continued his 'reunion' policy to expand eastward.

title.en: Kangxi Emperor's first southern tour to inspect Yellow River works

summary.en: The Kangxi Emperor toured south to Shandong and Jiangnan, inspecting the Yellow River, Huai River, and Grand Canal projects, and also visited the Confucius Temple to win over Han scholar-officials. The southern tours became a regular method of governance for Kangxi.

statement.zh:
康熙帝南巡至山东、江南，视察黄河、淮河和运河工程，并拜谒孔庙，笼络汉族士大夫。南巡成为他治理国家的常规手段。巡行兼有河工检查、地方吏治考察与文化示好，沿途减免与赏赐争取民心；尊孔有助于缓和满汉隔阂。治河与统战在巡行中结合。

把「康熙帝首次南巡，视察黄河治理」放回1684年的清，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Kangxi Emperor's first southern inspection tour

summary.en: The 9-year-old Kangxi Emperor, under the guidance of Grand Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang, made his first southern inspection tour, visiting the Yellow River conservancy projects. This gave him experience that later led to his focus on river and canal management.

title.en: Qing lift maritime ban, open Guangzhou and other trading ports

summary.en: The Kangxi Emperor abolished the coastal evacuation order, allowing coastal residents to return to their livelihoods, and opened four ports for foreign trade: Guangzhou, Xiamen, Ningbo, and Yuntaishan. Normal foreign trade with China resumed.

statement.zh:
康熙帝下令废除迁界令，允许沿海居民复业，并开放广州、厦门、宁波、云台山四口对外贸易。清朝与外国的正常贸易恢复。复业使沿海生计与盐渔业复苏，四口通商把贸易纳入官府管理；海禁的松弛与国策调整相连。东南沿海由此重新活跃。

title.en: Johann Sebastian Bach and George Frideric Handel born

summary.en: On March 21 (or 31), Bach was born in Eisenach, Germany; on February 23, Handel was born in Halle, Germany. Both are towering figures of Baroque music; though born in the same year, they never met.

statement.zh:
3月21日（或31日），巴赫在德国爱森纳赫出生；2月23日，亨德尔在德国哈雷出生。两人同属巴洛克音乐最杰出的代表，出生年份相近却从未谋面，这一巧合常被用来提示同一时代不同地域的音乐生态。把两条生平并置，也让巴洛克音乐的多样面貌更容易比较。

title.en: Sino-Russian border conflict at Albazin begins

summary.en: Qing general Peng Chun led forces to besiege the Russian outpost at Albazin (near present-day Mohe, Heilongjiang). Russian commander Aleksei Tolbuzin surrendered but later returned in violation of the agreement. The Qing besieged again, inflicting heavy Russian casualties.

statement.zh: 清军彭春率部围攻沙俄占据的雅克萨城（今黑龙江漠河附近），俄军托尔布津投降，但随后违约重返。清军二次围城，俄军伤亡惨重。

title.en: Louis XIV issues Edict of Fontainebleau, revoking Edict of Nantes

summary.en: On October 18, Louis XIV signed the Edict of Fontainebleau, declaring Protestantism illegal, destroying Huguenot churches, and forcing Huguenots to convert to Catholicism. About 200,000 Protestants fled to England, the Netherlands, Prussia, and elsewhere, causing a loss of skilled manpower and economic damage.

statement.zh:
10月18日，路易十四签署《枫丹白露敕令》，宣布新教非法，摧毁胡格诺派教堂，并强迫胡格诺派改宗天主教。约20万新教徒逃亡英国、荷兰、普鲁士等地，造成法国人才和经济损失。

1685年的法国，「路易十四颁布《枫丹白露敕令》，废除《南特敕令》」属于宗教领域。

title.en: Second siege of Albazin; Russian forces surrender

summary.en: Qing general Sabusu again besieged Albazin. Tolbuzin was killed by a cannonball. The remaining Russians surrendered. The Qing did not completely destroy the fort, leaving room for later negotiations.

statement.zh:
清军将领萨布素再次围攻雅克萨，俄军托尔布津被炮击身亡，剩余俄军投降。清廷并未完全摧毁城寨，为后续谈判留有余地。围城以炮火与封锁并举，守军粮弹俱尽；清军取胜后撤围，把军事胜利转为外交筹码。双方随后转向划界交涉。

把「清军第二次雅克萨之战，俄军投降」放回1686年的清，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: League of Augsburg formed to oppose French expansion

summary.en: The Holy Roman Empire, Spain, Sweden, Bavaria, and others formed the League of Augsburg (also known as the Grand Alliance) to resist Louis XIV's territorial claims. This alliance formed the anti-French coalition in the Nine Years' War (1688-1697).
