title.en: First edition of Newton's 'Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica' published

summary.en: Newton submitted the manuscript of 'Principia' (in Latin) to the Royal Society in April; financed by Edmond Halley, it was formally published on 5 July 1687. It set out the law of universal gravitation and the three laws of motion, founding classical physics.

statement.zh: 牛顿向皇家学会提交《自然哲学的数学原理》手稿（4月），由哈雷出资刊印，次年（1687年7月5日）正式出版。
statement.en: Newton submitted the manuscript of 'Principia' (in Latin) to the Royal Society in April; financed by Edmond Halley, it was formally published on 5 July 1687.

title.en: Venetian shelling destroys Parthenon in Athens

summary.en: During a war with the Ottoman Empire, Venetian forces bombarded the Acropolis in Athens. A shell hit the Parthenon, which was being used by the Ottomans to store gunpowder, causing an explosion that destroyed the center of the temple. This was one of the worst destructions of a classical building.

statement.zh:
威尼斯军队在与奥斯曼帝国作战中炮击雅典卫城，一枚炮弹击中帕特农神庙内储存的火药，引发爆炸，摧毁了庙宇中部。这是古典建筑遭受的最严重破坏之一。

1687年的威尼斯，「威尼斯人炮击雅典帕特农神庙，造成严重破坏」属于军事领域。
statement.en: During a war with the Ottoman Empire, Venetian forces bombarded the Acropolis in Athens.

title.en: Qing establishes Taiwan Prefecture, formally ruling Taiwan

summary.en: The Qing set up one prefecture and three counties (Taiwan Prefecture, Taiwan County, Fengshan County, Zhuluo County) in Taiwan, all under Fujian Province. The first prefect was Jiang Yuying. The early Qing adopted a passive development policy, restricting immigration from the mainland.

title.en: Newton's 'Principia' officially published

summary.en: Newton's great work was formally issued (though the title page bears 1687). It is considered the greatest scientific book ever written, making physics an exact science.

statement.zh:
牛顿的巨著正式发行（虽然版权页标1687年）。该书被公认为科学史上最伟大的著作，使物理学成为一门精确科学。全书以公理化的方式组织运动与引力，把天体与地面现象纳入同一套定律；数学证明与观测对照使结论可检验。它改变了自然研究的方法与地位。

把「牛顿《自然哲学的数学原理》正式出版」放回1687年的英格兰，可以看到科技变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Newton's magnum opus is officially released (although the copyright page is marked 1687).

title.en: English Bill of Rights establishes constitutional monarchy

summary.en: On December 16, Parliament passed the Bill of Rights, stipulating that the king may not suspend laws, levy taxes, or maintain a standing army without parliamentary consent, and guaranteeing free elections and parliamentary privilege. It established constitutional monarchy in England.

statement.zh: 12月16日，议会通过《权利法案》，规定国王不得废止法律、未经议会同意不得征税和维持常备军、保障议会议员选举自由等。

title.en: John Locke publishes 'Two Treatises of Government'

summary.en: Locke completed the 'Two Treatises' while in exile in the Netherlands, critiquing the divine right of kings and proposing social contract theory and the right of the people to resist tyranny. It became a classic of liberal political philosophy.

statement.zh: 洛克在荷兰流亡期间完成《政府论》（上下篇），批判君权神授，提出社会契约论和人民有权反抗暴政。该书成为自由主义政治哲学的经典。上篇逐条驳斥君权神授的论证，下篇以自然权利、契约与分权重建政府合法性；财产与劳动的联系、立法至上的主张影响深远。它为近代宪政提供了语言。

title.en: Fort William built in Bombay; English East India Company strengthens base

summary.en: The English East India Company built Fort William in Bombay (Mumbai) as a hub for trade with the West Indies. Bombay gradually replaced Surat as the company's main port in India.

statement.zh:
英国东印度公司在孟买建威廉堡，作为西印度群岛贸易的枢纽。孟买逐渐取代苏拉特成为英国在印度的主要港口。堡垒兼具仓储、驻军与关税职能，港口面向阿拉伯海与西印度的航线；随贸易与移民增加，城市在堡垒周边扩展。

把「孟买的威廉堡建成，英国东印度公司强化据点」放回1690年的英格兰，可以看到经济变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: Treaty of Limerick ends Williamite War in Ireland

summary.en: In October, William III signed a treaty with the remaining Irish Catholic forces, allowing Catholics to retain limited rights, but the terms were broken by the Irish Parliament, leading to long-term Catholic oppression in Ireland.

title.en: Duolun Assembly: Kangxi Emperor incorporates Khalkha Mongols

summary.en: In the fifth lunar month, the Kangxi Emperor met with the chieftains of the Khalkha Mongols (Outer Mongolia) at Duolun Nor (present-day Duolun, Inner Mongolia), mediating their internal disputes and formally incorporating them into the Qing realm. The Khalkha were organized into banners with appointed zasaks (hereditary heads).

title.en: French mathematician Rolle states Rolle's theorem

summary.en: In 1691, French mathematician Michel Rolle, in his work 'Traité d'Algèbre', stated a theorem concerning the nature of roots of polynomial equations (Rolle's theorem). It is a foundation for the mean value theorem in calculus, though its importance was not fully appreciated at the time.

statement.zh:
公元1691年，法国数学家米歇尔·罗尔（Michel Rolle）在其著作《无穷小分析》中提出了一项关于多项式方程根的性质定理（罗尔定理）。罗尔定理是微分学中值定理的基础，但当时其重要性未被充分认识。

1691年的法国，「法国数学家罗尔提出罗尔定理」属于科技领域。

title.en: Salem witch trials begin

summary.en: In Salem, Massachusetts, several girls claimed to have been bewitched, triggering a massive witch-hunt. By May of the following year, about 200 people had been accused, and 20 were executed. The case became a classic example of judicial injustice and mass hysteria.

statement.zh: 马萨诸塞塞勒姆镇几个女孩声称被女巫施咒，引发大规模猎巫潮。至次年5月，约200人被指控，20人被处决。该案成为司法不公和群体歇斯底里的典型案例。指控以幻象与传闻为据，法庭采信“幽灵证据”；社区积怨、土地纠纷与宗教紧张借机爆发。事后反思与平反缓慢到来。

title.en: French navy defeated by Anglo-Dutch fleet at La Hogue

summary.en: On May 29, an Anglo-Dutch fleet defeated the French fleet at La Hogue (Cotentin Peninsula, France), preventing the planned French invasion of England. After that, France abandoned major fleet engagements and turned to commerce raiding.

title.en: Kangxi Emperor approves compilation of 'Collected Compendium of Mathematical Principles'

summary.en: The Kangxi Emperor ordered the compilation of the 'Lüli Yuanyuan' (Source of Musical Tuning and Calendar Mathematics) series, which included the 'Collected Compendium of Mathematical Principles', an encyclopedia of mathematics that incorporated Western mathematical knowledge and promoted Chinese mathematics.

statement.zh: 康熙帝下令编撰《律历渊源》丛书，其中包括《御制数理精蕴》（数学百科全书），吸收西方数学知识，推动中国数学发展。编纂由宫廷主持，耶稣会士与汉人学者合作，把几何、代数与历算纳入统一体系；数学既服务于历法与测量，也成为宫廷学术的一部分。中西知识的汇通由此推进。
statement.en: Emperor Kangxi ordered the compilation of the "Yuan of Laws and Calendars" series, including the "Imperial Mathematics Essence" (Encyclopedia of Mathematics), to absorb Western mathematical knowledge and promote the development of Chinese mathematics.

title.en: French establish outpost on Lake Pontchartrain (precursor to New Orleans)

summary.en: French explorer Pierre Le Moyne d'Iberville established a settlement on the Mississippi River, later to become New Orleans. The settlement became the capital of French Louisiana.

statement.zh: 法国探险家皮埃尔·勒穆瓦纳·迪贝维尔在密西西比河附近建立殖民点，后发展为新奥尔良，该地成为法属路易斯安那的首府。殖民点选在河口的潟湖与河湾之间，便于船只进出与防御；移民、传教与毛皮贸易随之展开，与原住民的关系在合作与冲突间摆动。法国借此把密西西比流域纳入帝国版图。

title.en: Great famine in Bengal kills about 300,000

summary.en: Drought, compounded by grain hoarding by British East India Company merchants, caused a severe famine in Bengal, with an estimated 300,000 dead. This deepened local resentment against British colonizers.

statement.zh:
英属印度孟加拉地区因干旱和英国东印度公司粮商囤积居奇，爆发严重饥荒，死亡人数约30万。这一事件加剧了当地对英国殖民者的仇恨。歉收与囤积使粮价飞涨，殖民行政的救济不足；饥荒暴露了贸易公司兼理政务的弊端。经济控制转为政治怨恨。

把「孟加拉发生饥荒，约30万人死亡」放回1693年的莫卧儿帝国，可以看到灾难变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Due to drought and the hoarding of grain merchants by the British East India Company, severe famine broke out in the Bengal region of British India, killing about 300,000 people.

title.en: Kangxi Emperor restores provincial examinations (xiangshi) to win over Han literati

summary.en: In the 32nd year of Kangxi (1693), the Kangxi Emperor ordered the resumption of provincial examinations across the country. Because of the Three Feudatories War and the Taiwan campaign, the civil service exams had been interrupted in some provinces. Restoring them brought many Han Chinese literati into the bureaucracy, effectively easing Manchu-Han tensions. Earlier (1679), Kan

statement.zh: 清康熙32年（1693年），康熙帝下令在全国范围内恢复乡试。因三藩之乱和台湾战事，部分省份的科举考试被迫中断。恢复乡试选拔了大批汉族士人进入官僚体系，有效缓和了满汉矛盾。此前（1679年）康熙还开设了博学鸿词科征召隐逸名士。这些文化政策巩固了清朝在汉族地区的统治基础。
statement.en:
In the 32nd year of Kangxi (1693), the Kangxi Emperor ordered the resumption of provincial examinations across the country. Because of the Three Feudatories War and the Taiwan campaign, the civil service exams had been interrupted in some provinces. Restoring them brought many Han Chinese literati into the bureaucracy, effectively easing Manchu-Han tensions. Earlier (1679), Kangxi had also held a special Boxue Hongci examination to recruit reclusive scholars. These cultural policies consolidated Qing rule over Han Chinese regions.

For Asia in 1693, “Kangxi Emperor restores provincial examinations (xiangshi) to win over Han literati” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Kangxi Emperor orders compilation of 'Kangxi Dictionary'

summary.en: In the 33rd year of Kangxi (1694), the Kangxi Emperor ordered Grand Academician Zhang Yushu, Hanlin scholar Chen Tingjing, and others to compile a large dictionary of Chinese characters. Completed after six years, it contained 47,035 characters, following the format of the earlier 'Zihui' and 'Zhengzitong', and became the standard Qing-era dictionary.

title.en: France introduces the capitation head tax

summary.en: On 18 January 1695 Louis XIV issued a declaration establishing the capitation, a head tax to finance the War of the League of Augsburg. It divided every subject into twenty-two classes by rank rather than wealth: the Dauphin paid 2,000 livres a year and princes of the blood 1,500, down to day labourers and servants at one livre, with exemption only for mendicant friars and for

statement.zh: 1695年1月18日，路易十四为筹措大同盟战争的军费颁布敕令，开征"人头税"（capitation）。此税按身份地位而非财产把全体臣民分为二十二等：上自王太子年纳2000里弗尔、亲王1500里弗尔。下至日工与仆役各纳1里弗尔；仅托钵修会与经本堂神父证明的赤贫者获免——这是法国第一个在原则上不豁免贵族与教士的直接税。教士随即以每年包缴四百万里弗尔换取集体免于逐人课征，各行省与城镇亦纷纷以定额包税自保，贵族则争得自行推举估税员之权。实际负担仍层层下压到平民。该税1697年战后废止，1701年因西班牙王位继承战争恢复，1704年成为常制，直至大革命方才取消。
statement.en: On 18 January 1695 Louis XIV issued a declaration establishing the capitation, a head tax to finance the War of the League of Augsburg. It divided every subject into 22 classes by rank rather than wealth: the Dauphin paid 2,000 livres a year and princes of the blood 1,500, down to day labourers and servants at one livre, with exemption only for mendicant friars and for the poor certified by their parish priest. It was the first French direct tax that in principle spared neither nobility nor clergy. The clergy at once bought off individual assessment with a lump four million livres a year, provinces and towns compounded for fixed sums, and the nobles won the right to appoint their own assessors, so that the burden slid back onto commoners. Abolished in 1697 at the end of the war, the tax was revived in 1701 for the War of the Spanish Succession, made permanent in 1704, and lasted until the Revolution.

zh: 1695年1月18日，路易十四为筹措大同盟战争的军费颁布敕令，开征"人头税"（capitation）。此税按身份地位而非财产把全体臣民分为二十二等：上自王太子年纳2000里弗尔、亲王1500里弗尔。下至日工与仆役各纳1里弗尔；仅托钵修会与经本堂神父证明的赤贫者获免——这是法国第一个在原则上不豁免贵族与教士的直接税。教士随即以每年包缴四百万里弗尔换取集体免于逐人课征，各行省与城镇亦纷纷以定额包税自保，贵族则争得自行推举估税员之权。实际负担仍层层下压到平民。该税1697年战后废止，1701年因西班牙王位继承战争恢复，1704年成为常制，直至大革命方才取消。
en: On 18 January 1695 Louis XIV issued a declaration establishing the capitation, a head tax to finance the War of the League of Augsburg. It divided every subject into 22 classes by rank rather than wealth: the Dauphin paid 2,000 livres a year and princes of the blood 1,500, down to day labourers and servants at one livre, with exemption only for mendicant friars and for the poor certified by their parish priest. It was the first French direct tax that in principle spared neither nobility nor clergy. The clergy at once bought off individual assessment with a lump four million livres a year, provinces and towns compounded for fixed sums, and the nobles won the right to appoint their own assessors, so that the burden slid back onto commoners. Abolished in 1697 at the end of the war, the tax was revived in 1701 for the War of the Spanish Succession, made permanent in 1704, and lasted until the Revolution.

title.en: Treaty of Ryswick signed; Nine Years' War ends

summary.en: On September 20, France and the Grand Alliance signed the Treaty of Ryswick. France returned most of its conquests but retained Strasbourg. Louis XIV abandoned his support for the Jacobite cause.

statement.zh:
9月20日，法国与大同盟各国签订《里斯维克和约》，法国归还大部分占领地，但保留斯特拉斯堡。路易十四放弃对英国詹姆斯二世的支持。和约承认威廉三世为英国国王，划定莱茵河与北美的边界，法国以退让换取喘息；列强均势的格局在谈判桌上初步成形。

title.en: Charles XII of Sweden ascends the throne at age 15

summary.en: On April 5, Charles XI died, and his 15-year-old son Charles XII became king. Neighboring Denmark, Poland, and Russia took advantage to form an anti-Swedish coalition, leading to the Great Northern War (1700).

statement.zh:
4月5日，查理十一世去世，其子查理十二世继位，年仅15岁。邻国丹麦、波兰、俄国趁机结成反瑞同盟，引发大北方战争（1700年）。

1697年的瑞典，「瑞典国王查理十二世继位，时年15岁」属于政治领域。

title.en: Galdan commits suicide; Dzungar Khanate temporarily submits to Qing

summary.en: The Kangxi Emperor made a third personal campaign. Abandoned by his followers, Galdan committed suicide near Kobdo. The new Dzungar khan, Tsewang Rabtan, submitted to the Qing, although he would later rebel again.

statement.zh:
康熙帝第三次亲征，噶尔丹在科布多附近众叛亲离，服毒自杀。准噶尔新汗策妄阿拉布坦向清廷臣服，但日后再度反叛。远征依托驿站与蒙古诸部的向背，补给与联盟决定成败；汗位更替使准噶尔暂时低头，却保留重新扩张的余地。草原与帝国的博弈仍在继续。

把「噶尔丹自杀，准噶尔汗国暂时臣服清朝」放回1697年的清，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。

title.en: France and England reach agreement to partition the Spanish Empire

summary.en: France and England secretly concluded the Treaty of The Hague (First Partition Treaty) to divide the Spanish territories after King Charles II's death, causing dissatisfaction among other powers.

statement.zh: 法英秘密签订《海牙条约》（第一次分治条约），试图在西班牙国王卡洛斯二世死后瓜分其领土，引起其他列强不满。分治方案以均势为名，实则绕开西班牙与奥地利，把继承问题变成大国交易；未获补偿的列强转而支持其他继承人。秘密外交加剧了不信任，为西班牙王位继承战争埋下伏笔。
statement.en: France and Britain secretly signed the Treaty of the Hague (the First Partition Treaty) in an attempt to carve up Spanish territory after the death of King Carlos II, which aroused dissatisfaction among other powers.

title.en: Kangxi Emperor's third southern tour: emphasizes 'Manchu-Han unity'

summary.en: In the 38th year of Kangxi (1699), the Kangxi Emperor made his fifth southern inspection tour. He visited Shandong, Jiangnan, and Zhejiang, inspecting river works and receiving officials and gentry. During the tour, Kangxi stressed the policy of Manchu-Han unity, forbidding Manchu nobles from bullying Han Chinese. He personally went to the Ming tombs in Nanjing to pay respects

statement.zh: 清康熙38年（1699年），康熙帝进行第五次南巡。他巡视了山东、江南和浙江，沿途考察河工、接见官员士绅。南巡期间康熙强调满汉一体的统治方针，禁止满族贵族欺压汉人，并亲往南京明孝陵祭拜明太祖以笼络江南汉人士大夫。随行的法国传教士白晋等还进行了地理测绘。
statement.en:
In the 38th year of Kangxi (1699), the Kangxi Emperor made his fifth southern inspection tour. He visited Shandong, Jiangnan, and Zhejiang, inspecting river works and receiving officials and gentry. During the tour, Kangxi stressed the policy of Manchu-Han unity, forbidding Manchu nobles from bullying Han Chinese. He personally went to the Ming tombs in Nanjing to pay respects to the Hongwu Emperor, winning over Jiangnan literati. The accompanying French Jesuit Bouvet and others conducted geographical surveys.

For Asia in 1699, “Kangxi Emperor's third southern tour: emphasizes 'Manchu-Han unity'” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: King Charles II of Spain dies; will leaves throne to French Duke of Anjou

summary.en: On November 1, the childless King Charles II of Spain died. His will named Philip, Duke of Anjou (grandson of Louis XIV of France), as his successor, violating the partition agreements among European powers and leading to the War of Spanish Succession (1701-1714).

title.en: Cheyenne migration to the Plains

summary.en: The Cheyenne moved from the woodlands onto the Plains, known for tipi camps, bison hunting and military societies as a major Plains people.

statement.zh: 夏延人从林地西迁至大平原，以帐篷聚落、野牛狩猎与军事会社著称，成为平原重要部族。迁徙与马匹的获得改变了他们的生活节奏，野牛群的行踪决定聚落的移动与季节性的集会；军事会社与年龄等级分担狩猎、作战与仪式，使大型营地在无固定城邑的条件下仍能组织起来。这种以移动与联盟为基础的社会形态，是平原文化的典型。
statement.en: The Cheyenne moved westward from the woodlands to the Great Plains and became famous for their tent settlements, buffalo hunting, and military societies, becoming an important tribe in the Plains.

title.en: Lakota expansion onto the Great Plains

summary.en: The Lakota (a Sioux division), after acquiring horses, moved west onto the North American Plains and built a bison-centered nomadic horse culture.

statement.zh: 拉科塔（苏族一支）由东部林地带引入马后向西进入北美大平原，发展出以野牛为中心的游牧骑马文化。马匹提高了狩猎与迁徙能力，野牛皮、肉与骨成为生活的基础，帐篷营地随兽群移动；战争与仪式也围绕马与野牛展开。这种文化在十九世纪后期因猎杀野牛与殖民扩张而剧变。
statement.en: The Lakota (a branch of the Sioux) introduced horses from the eastern forest zone and then moved westward into the Great Plains of North America, developing a nomadic horseback riding culture centered on bison.

statement.en: This culture changed dramatically in the late 19th century due to buffalo hunting and colonial expansion.

title.en: Great Northern War breaks out: Russia, Denmark, Poland attack Sweden

summary.en: In February, Saxony (Polish King Augustus II) attacked Riga, then Denmark and Russia joined, aiming to partition Sweden's Baltic territories. Swedish King Charles XII rapidly counterattacked, defeating Denmark and Russia. The war lasted until 1721.

statement.zh: 2月，萨克森（波兰国王奥古斯特二世）攻克里加，随后丹麦和俄国相继参战，意图瓜分瑞典波罗的海领地。
